Imagine a world where communication transcends the spoken word, where thoughts can be effortlessly transmitted from one mind to another. Welcome to the fascinating realm of telepathic conversations. This extraordinary phenomenon has captivated human imagination for centuries, sparking curiosity about the possibilities of mind-to-mind communication. In this article, we will delve into the concept of telepathy, explore its potential implications, and examine the existing scientific research in this intriguing field.

Unveiling Telepathy
Telepathy, derived from the Greek words "tele" (meaning distant) and "patheia" (meaning feeling), refers to the ability to communicate thoughts, ideas, and emotions directly from one mind to another, bypassing the need for traditional verbal or written communication. It implies a direct sharing of consciousness, enabling individuals to perceive and understand each other's thoughts and feelings on a deeper level.

Historical Perspectives
Telepathic communication has long been a subject of fascination and mystique throughout history. Ancient civilizations, such as the Greeks, Egyptians, and Native Americans, believed in the power of telepathy and considered it an inherent ability of certain individuals, often revered as "seers" or "mystics." Tales of mind readers, psychic connections, and telepathic communication continue to be prevalent across different cultures, reinforcing the belief that such an ability may exist.

The Modern Viewpoint
While the concept of telepathic conversations remains controversial in the scientific community, recent advancements in neuroscience and parapsychology have renewed interest in investigating the potential legitimacy of this phenomena.

Exploring the Science
Researchers have conducted numerous experiments to shed light on the existence and mechanisms of telepathy. Some studies focus on exploring the phenomenon in controlled laboratory settings, using methods such as sender-receiver pairs, brain imaging technology, and statistical analysis. Though results have been mixed, some studies indicate statistically significant results, providing tantalizing glimpses into the possibility of telepathic communication.

The Power of the Mind
Advancements in the field of neuroimaging have revealed intriguing findings regarding the brain's role in telepathic communication. Studies suggest that specific areas of the brain associated with empathy, mirroring, and intentionality may play a crucial role in facilitating telepathic connections. Understanding the intricate workings of these neural networks could potentially unlock the secrets behind our ability to communicate telepathically.

Practical Applications
The potential applications of telepathic communication extend far beyond mere fascination. If harnessed effectively, telepathy could revolutionize the way we communicate, breaking down language barriers and allowing individuals with conditions such as locked-in syndrome or severe speech impairments to express themselves more easily.

Ethical Considerations and Challenges
As with any powerful technology or ability, telepathic communication brings forth ethical considerations and challenges. Privacy concerns, misinterpretation of thoughts, and the erosion of personal boundaries are among the key considerations when envisioning a future with widespread telepathy. These issues must be addressed, and rigorous ethical guidelines must be established to ensure responsible use of telepathic communication.

Conclusion
While telepathic conversations still reside on the fringes of science and society, the tantalizing possibilities they offer continue to intrigue and inspire. Exploring the boundaries of human consciousness, unlocking secrets of the mind, and forging connections without words—telepathy has the potential to both revolutionize and challenge our understanding of communication. As scientific discoveries progress and ethical frameworks evolve, we may find ourselves standing at the brink of a new era, where the power of thought is unleashed in ways we never thought possible.

Unlock your mind's potential and embark on a journey into the extraordinary world of telepathic conversations!
op.title: The Incredible Power of Telepathic Conversations: Unlocking the World of Mind-to-Mind Communication

Once upon a time, in a realm beyond our own, existed a group of extraordinary beings known as the 144,000 Radiant Guardians. Born from the remnants of dying stars, they possessed unparalleled powers that emanated pure luminescence from their very core.

The Radiant Guardians were not ordinary beings, but rather ethereal warriors, entrusted with the sacred task to maintain balance and protect the cosmic order in the universe. Each warrior possessed a unique ability, harnessing the essence of light in its purest form. Together, they formed an unstoppable force wielding the power of the stars themselves.

In the heart of the cosmos, amidst the vast expanse of galaxies, a looming darkness known as Nekron sought to engulf all radiant light. Nekron was an ancient entity, fueled by envy and consumed by a hunger for absolute power. It continuously grew stronger, threatening to plunge the universe into eternal darkness.

When the call for help echoed across the cosmos, the 144,000 Radiant Guardians responded. Their shining armor, infused with the hues of a thousand stars, flickered radiantly as they united against the impending darkness. In a grand display of cosmic spectacle, they embarked on their quest to thwart Nekron's nefarious plans.

Leading them was Lumina, a charismatic and fearless warrior who had the ability to manipulate light at will. Her radiant aura commanded attention as she inspired her fellow Guardians with unwavering hope and determination. At her side, Solarius, the mighty defender, summoned solar flares to shield his companions from Nekron's relentless darkness.

As they ventured deeper into the cosmos, the Radiant Guardians faced numerous challenges, each one testing the limits of their abilities. They battled monstrous creatures made of shadows, their brilliance piercing through the darkness and illuminating the path ahead. With their collective strength and unwavering unity, they overcame each obstacle, growing brighter with every victory.

As the ultimate confrontation loomed, Nekron unleashed his darkness in a catastrophic supernova, threatening to snuff out all illumination. In the face of this impending doom, the Radiant Guardians summoned their inner strength, their brilliance merging together to create a colossal burst of light that shattered through the shadows.

With hearts ablaze and unwavering determination, the 144,000 Radiant Guardians stood tall as they faced Nekron. In a breathtaking display of sheer brilliance, they launched a blinding attack, banishing Nekron's darkness back into the void from whence it came. The universe rejoiced as light reclaimed its rightful place.

The majestic tale of the 144,000 Radiant Guardians echoed across the cosmos, forever etching their courageous deeds in the hearts of beings from all realms. Their story serves as a reminder that even in the darkest of times, the brilliance within us all can overcome any darkness, bringing hope and inspiration to those who need it most.
op.title: Warriors of Brilliance: The 144,000 Radiant Guardians

The security breach on Facebook: Among the 50 million accounts that were also breached by Mark Zuckerberg and the vice president of operations, Cheryl Sandberg.

Because of this, there was a mass forced disconnection from Facebook  And there was a need to reconnect!!
If you are disconnected from the application and are required to re-enter, then you are on the list of "casualties" 

Explain the breakout and how to protect yourself  !


 
  	
The engineers found a weakness in the "Preview" button that allows viewing the profile as it looks to other surfers. The problem is that this tool revealed a digital key that allows people to access Facebook from the device without the need for a password, meaning that they identify with Facebook using the key. An attacker could use the firewall to log on to an account that does not belong to it. The workers realized that 50 million people had been hurt by this breach
What to do?

To see if someone has already signed in to your account, go to the Login and Security page and check the list of devices you're connected to, if you're unfamiliar with a foreign device. If you've identified one, just delete it with a click.

Password - Facebook say there is no need to change password because the loophole has been blocked but it is always advisable to change password for each case. We recommend a different password from other accounts, integrated characters and not short.

2-Step Verification - Enabling 2-Step Verification requires you to enter a special code that you will receive in the message even after you have already entered a password in an attempt to connect. This prevents an attacker from accessing your account if it only has a password because it must physically hold your device to access. Please note that recently in the media it was revealed that Facebook uses a cell phone number that you submitted for two-stage verification for advertising purposes. So for your consideration.
op.title: The security breach in Facebook : Among the 50 million accounts that were hacked also Mark Zuckerberg's account

The last year in the garden was fascinating and packed with activity. We have seen our compound evolve and grow, and the community expands and becomes stronger. For example, volunteers helped prepare the tent for the winter and built a large, beautiful greenhouse. The day-to-day activities included a weekly visit by a group of students from the Vilkomich school, meetings for the general public and countless classes, Shabbat receptions, music events, and even dance parties. On Hanukkah the garden hosted activities for children with a candle-lighting ceremony and in the weeks we had a huge picnic with an open stage. Purim, Independence Day and the longest day of the year were celebrated at outdoor dancing parties . There were also performances in the garden, such as the Alwan band, where 200 people attended. But the most amazing thing - after the vegetables and the flowers, of course - is the community that was created around the garden - a community that has become many for an alternative family.

op.author: headcorner
op.body:
![0148ed60-34c0-4602-8f7a-afaf94a8ad92.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmQKQKxnapJzwNTx1pYfn14BywseJsPpFfr3M1nFEvyQCT/0148ed60-34c0-4602-8f7a-afaf94a8ad92.jpg)![0bade967-e592-4229-9ae7-05a62737fef9.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmVcX4ECuj7T93fHgBhrmxwkcZL56PnzgN9vyckGTQnQTn/0bade967-e592-4229-9ae7-05a62737fef9.jpg)One of my best memories of my childhood is the annual trip to the Hutzot Hayotzer (artists colony) Festival in Jerusalem.
This is an Israeli / international artists' festival, The festival takes place once a year every summer in the Old City of Jerusalem. 
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmfUdSWzgke2BbnJW3j6ENGUdvajRN5QDx4kY97Q9TkvbD/WeChat%20Screenshot_20180820154205.png
http://artistscolony.co.il/about-the-place

When my partner's son grew up, (he is 10 years old) I wanted to give him this experience as well, So in the last 3 every summer we go up to Jerusalem for the festival

The purpose of the festival is to present art, artists, and artists from all over the world. The place is divided into 4 complexes, one featuring only local artists (handicrafts only). The two complex is a food complex, offering a wide range of dishes from all the oysters. The third area is the international complex and the main one! Which is the most interesting because of the arrival of artists from around the world who display their culture and the work from where they come from, in every stand written the name and the country of origin, we saw many beautiful things and we enjoyed the most to see cultures and people from different places in the world. 
The fourth complex is the performance tribune, and every day there are some of Israel's leading musicians.

If you are interested in getting more information you can go to the official website of the festival
http://artistscolony.co.il/home-page

I will add a few photos we have taken (not much but you will see on the festival's website more)

op.author: headcorner
op.body:
Australian researchers have announced a breakthrough and impressive first success in eradicating "dengue fever," one of the diseases spread and transmitted by mosquitoes.

Dengue fever is a multi-systemic disease manifested in the first phase of the fever, sometimes accompanied by pain and rash, followed by a rare stage in which the patient may lose fluids and bleed. 

During the critical stage, the disease may become complicated and take the form of dengue shock syndrome or dengue hemorrhagic fever, especially when it is a second infection other than the same strain of the virus. Treatment of the disease is only supportive, while prevention focuses mainly on protection against mosquitoes that transmit the disease and control its distribution areas. 

In Townsville, Queensland, mosquitoes were born captive and naturally carried a bacteria called "Wolbachia" that delays the transmission of dengue fever. 

The mosquitoes released were mated with the older mosquitoes in the city, and so the bacteria was gradually transferred to all the mosquitoes. Thus, a whole city was cleared of dengue fever with natural biological means, effectively and relatively cheaply - about $ 15 per person.

The researchers hope to use the same method to eradicate the deadly malaria disease and other serious diseases that cause deaths in third world countries.The next project of the researchers is in the city of Indonesia. The researchers hope to further streamline the process and even lower the cost per dollar per person.

The Council estimates that exports of the Indian gem and jewelry industry may decline at a similar rate. According to the council, India's gem and jewelry exports registered an annual decline of 8.84 percent in April-June 2018, amounting to $ 10.1 billion. Chairman of the Council for the Promotion of Gems and Jewelry Export from India, Pramod Agrawal, said: "The Council is making efforts to self-control and confidence among key stakeholders through many reforms. However, the industry has experienced various crises, as banks have reduced their lending to traders and require collateral and extensive documentation. In such a situation, the gem and jewelry industry, which exports about $ 41 billion, will record a gradual decline in fiscal year 2018-19. " The council's deputy chairman, Colin Shah, added, "Banks continue to insist that all customer invoices be routed through the bank. It interferes with cash flow on a daily basis. The banks also canceled all the benefits on assessment fees, which led to an increase in financing costs. " 

The gem and diamond market has been in a slowdown for several years, all over the world not only in India but throughout the world.

We are also feeling a slowdown in the Israeli market

We will continue to follow the changes and developments in the global gemstone market. And we will try to identify the next trend in the market. Such as laboratory diamonds and synthetic gems

source: https://libreshot.com/

Anyone who looks up to the sky tonight (Friday) will see a full and long lunar eclipse. The eclipse, which will be seen throughout the world as well as in Israel, is also called the "Blood Moon" and is expected to be the most powerful and longest in the current century.

source: pexels

At 10:30 pm the shadow of the earth will hide the moon from the sun and for an hour and forty-two minutes it will turn reddish, with the peak expected between 22:30 and 23:20. This is the longest eclipse in twenty years, partly due to the fact that the Moon is the largest distance in its orbit from Earth and therefore its movement in the sky will appear slower.The play will be seen from anywhere in the country, but to enjoy the starry sky that will appear in full splendor with the cover of the moon is recommended to stay away from the centers of large cities. For example, in the center of the Negev, the mountains of Eilat and the Judah  Hills, the play will be especially impressive.A chart of NASA:  

 
Eclipse time from Israel:
• Beginning of half-shadow eclipse - 20:14
• Beginning of partial eclipse - 21:24
• Beginning of full eclipse - 22:30
• Peak of eclipse - 23:22
• End of complete eclipse - 00:13
• completion of the partial eclipse 01:19
• end fault semi-shade - 02:28 

for more international info visit here https://www.timeanddate.com/eclipse/lunar/2018-july-27

As some of you knows, among other things, I deal with jewelry and fine gemstones. From time to time I post and bring information about gemstones and jewelry. If there is anything on the subject that could interest you, let me know i will be happy to help.


The most common color of diamonds is the white color, which usually appears with a yellow or sometimes a gray or brown color, the highest color called D, he is completely white, and the lowest color called Z with a clear yellow color.

  1. D, E, F - These are white stones, They are colorless, usually called "Collection." The difference between these colors is the transparency and clarity of the white color. These diamonds are the same as those of the Golconda region in India, which was the world's major supplier of diamonds from the 4th century BC to 1730. These diamonds belong to a type called Type 2A, It is indicated in a separate GIA certificate.  
  2. G , H - These stones have the slightest shade of yellow (or brown, or gray).
  3. I, J - These stones have a slight shade - medium of yellow (or brown or gray).
  4. K, L - These stones have a clear shade of yellow (or brown or gray)
  5. M , N - These stones have a strong shade of yellow (or brown or gray).
  6. N - Z - any stone that is yellower than a yellow N stone and less yellow - colored stone is called CAPE or DARK CAPE after the Cape District in South Africa, where the panic began in 1869. These colors are cheaper in the market, And traded according to supply and demand.The GIA ranks them by color range, for example: YZ or WX Range.
  7. FANCY YELLOW - Any stone that is yellower than Z is considered to have a special yellow color and its value increases accordingly.

op.body: מה מה קורה רונה את חייבת לספר לנו אל תשאירי אותנו במתח!

op.author: headcorner
op.body:
פוסט זה נכתב לכבוד תחרות הכתיבה העברית של הקבוצה הישראלית הנפלאה והמתפתחת שלנו!

מקור : pexels

בעברי הלא רחוק התעסקתי המון בקידום רשתות חברתיות, ואתרים למיניהם. האמת שלא בדיוק מצאתי את עצמי בתוך כל התחום הזה והיתה לי חסרה התחושת סיפוק שלי מעבודה שאני אוהב. 

את הלמידה והניסיון שלי צברתי בעזרת פורום אדיר שמתמקד בקידום רשתות חברתיות ואתרים, כל הזמן ניסיתי דברים חדשים וחיפשתי תוכנות ותוספים כדי לייעל את העבודה שלי, באחד הימים תוך שיחה בצ'ט של הפורום האדמין של האתר אמר שכל אחד מהחברים מצא את דרכו להרוויח ולהתפרנס מאחת מאלף האפשרויות שעולות לפורום כל יום, המשפט הזה ממש הדהד לי בראש במשך כמה ימים, וכל הזמן שאלתי את עצמי "מתי אמצא את הנישה המדויקת בשבילי? שארגיש ממנה סיפוק ואפיק את התועלת המירבית. 

ימים עברו ועדיין המשכתי לחפור ביותר מדי דברים ונסיונות, היו גם הצלחות רבות אבל עדיין היה חסר משהו והמשכתי לשאול את עצמי את אותה השאלה? מתי אני אמצא את הפינה שלי???? 

ואז זה קרה!

פוסט אחד קטן שאף אחד לא ממש התייחס אליו שבוא היה כתוב "איך הרווחתי 900$ בשבוע מפרסום של פוסטים ברשת חברתית חדשה"

אממ אמרתי לעצמי מעניין.. אני הרי אלוף ברשתות, אמנם פרסום פוסטים קצת פחות, אבל הרגשתי שזה ממש מושך אותי!

לאחר עיון קצת במדריך ששותף בפורום נרשמתי לsteemit!

חיכיתי בקוצר רוח לקבל את האישור במייל כדי לשמור טוב טוב את המפתח כמו שהיה כתוב במדריך.

וחיכיתי,

עוד יום

ועוד יום

טוב, אמרתי לעצמי כנראה כבר יש יותר מדי רשומים בפלטפורמה ואיחרתי את המועד..😓

כמובן שגם משיטוט קצת באתר לא הצלחתי להבין כלום~! (לא היה לי ניסיון קודם בבלוקצ'יין)

אוקי ממשיכים, די מבאס כי כבר הרגשתי שהנישה שהאדמין הבטיח שאמצא כבר רוקמת עור וגידים, אבל כנראה שלא.

שכחתי, המשכתי..

לאחר משהו כמו שבוע קיבלתי אימייל!!! תאמינו או לא זה היה מסטימיט!!! עם אישור כניסה לרשת ובחירת מפתח!!! וואוו

התרגשתי נורא! עדיין לא הבנתי כלום, לכן פיניתי לי זמן, לקחתי את הלפטופ, המפתח לחשבון, והמדריך מהפורום..

המדריך הזה היה די שטחי ומשעמם לא הצלחתי להבין ממנו יותר מדי ואיבדתי את הסבלנות..

אמרתי לעצמי: אני פשוט אתחיל לפרסם פוסטים גם ככה אני לא מכיר אף אחד ואף אחד לא מכיר אותי, נתחיל ולאט לאט כמו שאני מכיר רשתות אני אתחיל להבין

אני לא אשכח את ההצבעה הראשונה שקיבלתי! צ'יטה בוט! וואו איזה כיף יש פה בוטים שמצביעים איזה סבבה ואו נחמד

עוד פוסט יוצא לדרך באותה שניה הצבעה מצ'יטה! וואו איזה כיף חחח

ואז התחלתי לקבל טיפה הערות, הבנתי שצ'יטה מזהה חומר מועתק/גנוב

אוי ואבוי אמרתי לעצמי~! בדיוק בגלל זה הייתי צריך להיות קפדן עם המדריך אני כזה נוב אוףף

לא נורא לא קרה כלום נתחיל לפרסם חומר יותר מקורי ולא מועתק לגמרי

מפה לשם התחלתי להכיר הרבה אנשים חדשים, דיבורים בדיסקורד, תגובות, עניין !

הרגשתי משהו שונה לגמרי מכל הרשתות האחרות שאני ממש מתעב, עניין אמיתי! פחות שיט! התעניינות אמיתית יותר פתחיחות ופירגון

ממש התאהבתי

לאט לאט הכרתי עוד ועוד אנשים! ועוד עניין ויותר מעניין ודברים חדשים! ותוספים על הבלוקצ'יין של סטים! ווואוו זה מטורף זה ממש אין סופי!

האמת שהרגשתי מאוהב עוד מהרגע שראיתי את אותו הפוסט שמתאר 900$ בשבוע (שכמובן עוד לא הרווחתי)😊

מרגיש שאני כל יום לומד משהו חדש מהסטימיט, הצלחתי להבין ולהכיר עוד מטבעות ונושאים שקשורים לדיסקורד.

הכרתי אנשים שממש בראש שלי דרך הדיסקורד והתקדמתי עוד ועוד והיד עוד נטויה כמובן.

היום אני mod בשרת דיסקורד שנקרא Smart Media Group, שמטרתו לקדם קהילות נושאים וקבוצות בנושא בלוקצ'יין וסטימיט בפרט

 https://discord.gg/NZx5gC3  

חייב לציין שמאוד חשוב לי להיות חלק ולעזור בקידום קהילה הישראלית בסטימיט, אני מקווה מאוד להועיל ומקווה שנגדל ונהיה הכי תותחים בסטים!

זה היה סיפור האהבה הראשון שלי בסטימיט

יש לי עוד הרבה מה להוסיף אבל לא רוצה להכביד ביותר מדי מילים גם כדי שתוכלו לקרוא את זה, אוהב ומעריך ישר כוח!

The Israeli platform that enables the conversion of every cryptographic currency has suffered a security breach that allowed hackers to steal more than $ 20 million worth of coins.
The great promise of the Crypto world is supposed to bring us to a new era of decentralization, control and freedom of use in whatever currencies we want, There seems to be more work ahead. The Israeli Bancor (Bancor) platform, which allows conversion of any cryptographic currency such as Bitcoin to Token, has suffered a "security breach" in which tens of millions of dollars were stolen, forcing the company to freeze its activities.
How do you steal more than $ 20 million in one minute?
In the company's wink, Bancor tried to explain to its users what had happened: A wallet used by the company to update several smart contracts had been hacked by hackers, which attracted $ 12.5 million worth of ethereum coins, $ 1 million NPXS, and Bancor Tokens, Worth $ 10 million.
After the discovery of the breakthrough, the company was able to freeze its tokens , the BNT. 

The company explains that this is a possibility that was built precisely for such extreme cases, including hacking. Thus, in fact, burglars can not move the tokens from wallet to purse and finally sell or convert them to other currencies (including "real" money), thus running away with the money. Unfortunately for the company, it can not do the same process on ethereum or other currencies, but it claims to be working with other crypto exchanges to find the stolen money, and to ensure that the hackers can not exchange it and run away with it. Meanwhile, hackers have been able to convert part of the amount through the Changelly system, which is collaborating with Bancor in an attempt to locate the stolen amount.
Company: No harm was caused to customers
The company explains that no digital wallet of customers was hacked during the incident, and after the investigation the system will resume operations, probably during the next 24 hours. Meanwhile, company officials confirm that the reason for the breach was found and corrected. All of this apparently did not suffice for Bancor's Toucan holders, who dropped their value by more than 14%.
Bancor's platform enables the conversion of any cryptographic currency, thus allowing liquidity to be quite esoteric. Last year the company held ICO, during which it raised more than $ 150 million. This was the largest amount of ICO funding at the time (until Telegram held its ICO). Bancor was founded in 2016 by Guy Ben-Artzi, CEO of the company, Galia Ben-Artzi, business development manager, Yehuda Levy, director of technological development at the company, and Eyal Herzog, product manager. They were joined by American investor Tim Draper as a consultant, and Bernard Leiter, a well-known Belgian economist.
"We are still investigating the details of the break-in and will share further information when we can do so," Bancourt said in response. We take every such case seriously and use every resource at our disposal to solve the problem. The information we know is that $ 13.5 million was stolen from Bancor. No user's wallet was exposed to the breach, and no user money was stolen.
We work with dozens of crypto exchanges to locate the stolen funds, and to make it harder for the thieves to turn the funds into liquid. In addition, we identified the security breach, solved it and are now working to restore the network as quickly as possible. We will continue to update when we can use our telegraph channel and Twitter. " 


Source: https://www.geektime.co.il/bancor-hacked/ 

Source: pexeles

An unusual diamond in football shaped is found in Russia during the 2018 World Cup football matches in the country.

The diamond, shaped like a ball, is mostly white and small black spots adorn its face.

It was discovered at a diamond mine belonging to the Alrosa diamond mining group in the Krasnogorsk Oblast region of Russia.

Experts described the unusual shape and contours of the diamond as "a strange natural creation. "Some say that the little diamond is similar to the Adidas' classic "Telster" football ball, which was first used in Euro 1968 in Italy and 1970 World Cup in Mexico. Alrosa called the diamond after the name of Russian goalkeeper Igor Akinaviev.

— Mr G (@oddweirdbizarre) July 9, 2018

Every year, the editor of the popular American magazine, Research Magazine , ranks the world's strongest countries based on their alliances, global influence, political, economic, and military power and whether they are considered world leaders.
Here is a list of the top 25 countries, an opportunity to learn about them in a nutshell with the necessary salt and global changes and see representative pictures.
Did we manage to get in and where?  Answers below 👇

 25. Egypt 

The magazine defines Egypt as "one of the oldest and largest civilizations in the world." Most of the country's economic activity occurs along the Nile River Valley. Tourism, industry, and agriculture are important sectors, but political uncertainty is hurting economic growth.


 24. Singapore

Singapore is one of the busiest ports in the world, a "bustling metropolis," as the magazine puts it. In recent years the country has experienced a huge growth in its economy and population.


 23. Spain




 

Spain fell one place in the rankings since last year, due to a shaky economy and high unemployment. The crisis caused by Catalonia, which voted for independence, created yet another instability in the country, which is known for its art and culture and is very popular as a tourist site.


 22. Pakistan
 

Pakistan fell in two places due to instability, corruption and the ongoing conflict with India. The country is one of the youngest in the world, with most citizens under the age of 22.

 

 21. The Netherlands


 

Being a very open country, the Netherlands is increasingly grappling with immigration. The country with the highest income is one of the world's leading exporters in the field of agriculture. The International Court of Justice and the International Criminal Court are located in The Hague.
 

 20. Qatar
 

Qatar has risen in three places since last year, when oil and gas make it one of the richest countries in the world. It has a high standard of living, and its communications are among the independents in the Middle East. In 2022, it will be the first Middle Eastern country to host the World Cup, despite criticism of the state by the welfare authorities for deaths at construction sites and allegations of forced labor. 

 19. Sweden
 

Its commitment to human and human rights has made Sweden a respected international leader. With higher education and a free health care system, the country has one of the highest life expectancy in the world. 

 18. Italy
 


The political complications of the European immigration crisis led to an increase in populism in Italy, a new government and the potential for a future financial crisis. But the economy remains one of the largest in the euro area, and the magazine notes the country's strong cultural impact on the world, from art to food.
 

 17. Switzerland
 

The small country known for its neutrality has one of the highest GDP per person in the world and is on the world's leading list of Nobel prizes and patent lists for its population.

 16. Australia
 

 A rich country with a high expectancy and quality of life.
 

 15. India
 

India is the largest democracy in the world and until recently enjoyed one of the largest economies. But it is also one of the poorest countries in the world with a population of 1.3 billion people. It has become an important center of computer and computer services and is known for its amazing architecture.
 

 14. Turkey
 

Turkey has been affected by years of regional fighting and terrorism, including a failed military coup in 2016. It sits on the border between Europe and the Middle East, with common conflicts in neighboring countries. The OECD expects that Turkey will be one of the fastest growing companies in the coming years.

 13. Iran
 

Iran has risen on the list compared to 2017. One country has the largest economies in the Middle East and is interested in global forces thanks to its oil reserves. It is ruled by an authoritarian regime and criticized for the oppression of its citizens.

 12. Canada
 

The second largest country in the world, Canada is a significant energy exporter with large oil reserves. The country has a multiculturalism policy and Prime Minister Justin Trudeau has recently compared it to the neighboring United States, where inter-racial tensions have arisen.


 11. South Korea
 

South Korea has become the seventh largest exporter in the world, mainly thanks to foreign investment. The conflict with North Korea means that it enjoys the support of the world's powers ...


 10. United Arab Emirates
 

Oil exports enabled the UAE to enjoy similar GDP to that of the leading Western countries, according to the CIA World Factbook. The country is one of the most liberal in the region.
 

 9. Saudi Arabia
 

Within the borders of the country are most of the wealth and land of the Arabian Peninsula. It has a special status in the Muslim world as the home of Mecca, and its oil reserves have made it one of the richest countries in the Middle East. The state has recently begun to allow some of its prolonged restrictions on women, such as driving.

 8. Israel






 

Despite its strained relations with many of its neighbors and a population of only eight million, Israel has a large presence on the world stage, partly because of its close ties with the US Despite the Palestinian conflict, the country has a strong economy.
 

 7. Japan
 

Japan is one of the most advanced countries in the world and has the third largest economy in the world. The country is one of the world's largest manufacturers of cars, electronics and steel, and recently invested heavily in its military due to growing tensions with North Korea.

 6. France
 

The country has one of the largest economies in the world, and is often noted as a country with the largest number of tourists in the world. But it is facing an increase in terror and a changing public position toward immigration, as well as widespread unemployment among the younger generation.
 

 5. UK
 


 

Britain has fallen one place in the rankings since 2018 due to concern rising from its position on the world stage after the vote to leave the EU. London is an important financial center and still enjoys the influence that the country gained from the former British Empire.

 4. Germany
 

Germany rose this year, overtaking Britain. As the most populous country in the European Union, it has one of the largest economies in the world. The political leadership encountered opposition due to its open policy towards immigrants and the relative failure of Chancellor Angela Merkel in the 2017 elections weakened her position.
 

 3. China
 

China has enjoyed rapid economic progress, but many still live below the official poverty level of the country, the World Bank says. Its growing global influence has made the country more subject to criticism of its human rights policies, including censorship and limited freedom of communication.
 

 2. Russia
 

The largest country in the world is also one of the largest economies in the world. The country invests heavily in its military power, it spent 5.4 percent of its GDP on security in 2016, and tensions with Western countries have grown over issues such as the annexation of Crimea in 2014 and reported interference in the US presidential election in 2016.

 1. United States
 

The country with the greatest economic and military power in the world with a cultural stamp that reaches all over the globe. The United States has traditionally played a leading international role in organizations such as NATO and the United Nations, but internal challenges, including racial tensions, inequality and political disputes, are hurting the country.

This is the biggest conspiracy involving smart phones that refuses to disappear and die: Many people suspect their phones are listening to them in order to know what advertisements to show them. 

A number of academics tried to examine the subject over the past year, and in short, returned with a negative answer.

The researchers looked at the 17,260 popular apps in the Android app store, including the Facebook social network and an additional 8,000 that send information indirectly to Facebook; There was not a single instance of an application running the microphone or sending an audio clip unexpectedly when it was not asked to do so. Of all the applications, more than 9,000 had access to the camera and microphone of the device and had the "potential" to listen to the device owner, but they did not.Along with the siren, the researchers found several applications that sent screenshots and recorded video clips of user activity to a third party. For example, the "GoPuff" application belonging to a start-up for people who develop an inexplicable desire for junk food in the small hours of the night sent video footage of the interaction between the user and the application to an address belonging to Appsee, a commercial analytics company. In the above case, the user had no idea that his interaction was being sent out of the device. 

 Research and Results - https://recon.meddle.mobi/panoptispy
Source of Knowledge - https://gizmodo.com/these-academic-spent-the-last-year-testing-wether-you-1826961188/a>

A new family of Remote Control Tools (RATs), using the Telegram protocol to control devices and extract information from them, was discovered. How does the malware work (accompanied by demos?)
ESET researchers have discovered a new family of Remote Administration Tools (RATs) on Android systems that use the Telegram protocol to control devices and extract information from them. 

image source


While studying what appears to be increased activity from two previously reported malware attacks, IRRAT and TeleRAT, the researchers discovered a whole new malware family that has spread worldwide since August 2017. In March 2018, its source code was released for free on the hacking channels in Telegraph, Various versions of the Malware that rages in the field.
One of these versions is different from the others. 

Although the source code is available to everyone and for free, it is offered for sale on a dedicated telegram channel, where it is known as HeroRAT is available for purchase in 3 modes of payment according to the functions required of it, and with its acquisition access to a video support channel. It is unclear whether this version was created from the source code leaked or it is the "source" whose code was leaked.

How does the malware work?
The attackers cause the victims to download the remote control tools by distributing it under various tempting disguises through independent application stores, social networks and messaging applications. Distributed in Nukka, it distributes itself as an application that offers free Bitcoin coins, free internet connection, and other social network followers, especially in Iran. The malware did not appear in the Google Play store.

part of the camouflage used remote control tools for distributing
malware works in all versions of Android, but users who install malware, we must give it the permissions, it requires (among them managing an activation device), and this social engineering comes into play.


The remote control tool requests administrator privileges
Once the malware is installed and activated on the victim's device, a message pops up stating that the app can not run on the device and therefore will be removed from it. In parsed versions, the removal notice appears in English or Farsi depending on the user's language settings on the device.

After the removal ends, the app icon appears to have disappeared. However, on the part of the attacker, a new victim is recorded right now.

The creator of HeroRAT demonstrates the installation of the malware on his device (screenshot of a tutorial video given by the malware creator)

The malware code with fake removal messages in English and Persian

Once the attacker has access to the victim's device, he uses the Telegram function to control In the new device, each of the hacked devices is controlled by a bot, installed and activated by the attacker's telegraph application.

Malware has a wide range of spyware and file rescue capabilities, including intercepting messages and contacts, sending text and call messages, recording screen and audio, accessing the physical location of the device and controlling device settings.

HeroRAT is divided into 3 different "packages", bronze, silver and gold, offered for sale at $ 25, $ 50 and $ 100, respectively. The source code itself is offered for sale by the creator of HeroRAT for $ 650. Its

capabilities are available in the form of clickable buttons in the Telegram bot interface, and attackers can control hacked devices simply by clicking on the buttons available in the version of the malware, operators.


control panel HeroRAT functions of HeroRAT - versions "bronze", "silver" and 'Gold', from left to right (screenshots and video tutorial given by malware authors)

Unlike the previous malicious remote control tools, which were found in Java, the standard language for Android systems, this new malware family was developed from scratch using the C # language and the Xamarin framework - a rare combination of Android malware.

The manner in which the nanoseconds communicate with the telegram protocol has been adapted to its programming language. Instead of using the Telegram Bot API, which is used by the remote control tools previously surveyed, this malware family uses Telesharp, a library used to create a teliagram using the C # programming language.

The transfer of commands to the device and the removal of information from the device are done using a protocol only, a means to prevent the identification of the malware, which is usually done by monitoring traffic to known upload servers.

How to defend yourself?
Since the source code of the malware has become available to everyone recently, it is now possible to develop and distribute new versions anywhere in the world. Because the distribution method and how this malware is disguised varies from case to case, it's not enough to look for specific apps on your device to see if it's hacked.

If you are concerned that your device has been hacked by this malware, scan your device with a reliable security solution for mobile devices, and

avoid using the official Google Play app store to download applications, be sure to read the user reviews before downloading any app And note which permissions you give to applications, even before installation.

US citizens hold about 40% of the world's guns, more than all 25 countries on the list, according to a new study, "The most significant purchasing power of arms comes from the US civilian sector, and these percentages are likely to grow" 

According to the study, not only the Americans have the highest percentage of weapons per person, but between 2006 and 2017, 122 million weapons were purchased in US, out of a total of 207 million weapons purchased by citizens all over the world. 

the approximately that there is 1 billion weapons in the world, US citizens hold 393 million, to a population of 326 million, a ratio of 121 weapons per 100 citizens, and the following countries are in the ratio of rifles per person: Yemen (53), Serbia and Serbia (39)
On the other side, Japan and Indonesia have less than one weapon per 100 civilians."American citizens buy about 14 million domestic and imported weapons every year," said Aaron Karp, one of the authors of the study at a UN headquarters meeting."Why do they buy?" Karp was asked. "Well above all, they buy mainly because they can, the American market is very permissive in this matter."In a conversation with the British Independent newspaper, Karp said that most American weapons are not properly listed, but he is very confident in the reliability of the numbers he presents. 

The information he is reporting indicates a significant increase in the purchase of private weapons in the last 10, 20 and 30 years.

Karp emphasizes that the requirements for carrying weapons in the United States are very low and the requirements vary from state to state, so that many weapons go from place to place and remain unregistered, 

for example in New York and Connecticut, citizens must register and be permitted to carry semi-automatic pistols and weapons, in the US countries you simply enter the store and buy weapons instead. "Collecting the data and data for the study was very challenging, but Karp says he and the team worked hard to get information on 393 million registered and unregistered weapons. "Some of the numbers are low, some are high, but we are very confident in them."Information on weapons was available in 133 countries and territories worldwide, and surveys were conducted in 56 countries, which contributed to the completion of the information.
Only 28 countries released information on the stock of military weapons, and in 28 other countries, information on weapons was shared by the law enforcement authorities (police, security guards, etc.). 

Source:  https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/gun-ownership-country-us-legal-firearm-citizens-statistics-a8406941.html?utm_campaign=Echobox&utm_medium=Social&utm_source=Twitter#Echobox=1529432071

The Israeli high-tech company Spot.IM will allow its employees to receive a salary in Bitcoin. The company, which employs some 50 people in Tel Aviv and New York, has been negotiating with the tax authorities over the past month to prepare a request for it. The negotiations with the tax authorities relate mainly to the calculation of the conversion rate - a critical parameter for the employer and employees, and the company sent a letter to the ministers of the economy, labor, and social affairs.


Attorney Itay Bracha, who accompanies Spot.IM from the legal point of view said that according to the Tax Authority's circular, all the money and equal money or benefit is given to the employee, the tax authority sees them as part of the employee's taxable income. And will be transferred by the employer to the National Insurance Institute, the pension funds, etc. Only the net income will enable the receipt of a salary in Bitcoin, and any gain from the appreciation of the currency will be taxed at a capital gains tax rate of 25%.

9 US states have already approved a legal cannabis market but federal law still sets a total ban.US President Donald Trump announced on Friday that he was expected to support a new bill that would put an end to the age of banning cannabis in the United States, which began about 90 years ago.The new bill, promoted by the two parties, will allow each country to regulate the cannabis market in its entirety, including the establishment of factories, shops and the permitting of domestic growth and self-use - all without fear of DEA's claims and raids.The remarks - contrary to the position of Justice Minister Jeff Sessions, who is fighting legalization supporters - Trump said as he boarded the plane on his way to the summit of the G7 countries in Canada, where the Senate on Thursday approved full legalization that is expected to come into force until September .When asked by reporters about the bill, Trump replied that he supported the position of Sen. Currie Gardner of Colorado, one of the initiators of the new law and the one who confronted the issue with Sessions."I know exactly what he's doing," said Trump. "We're looking at it, but I'll probably support it, yes."Gardner has already noted a few weeks ago that the president personally authorized him to support the law, but this is the first time Trump has said that in his voice.Since the year 2012, nine states have approved the regulation of the cannabis market legally as alcohol - 8 of them (Washington, Colorado, Alaska, Oregon, Maine, Nevada, California) have done so after voting in a referendum, This was last year for the first time in a government decision.

For the first time, two Chinese brands entered the top ten in BrandZ's annual rankings. Google ranked eighth in the last 12 years 

photo source  : BOBBY YIP / Reuters

At the top of BrandZ's global brand rankings, you can see the largest technology companies in the world each year: Google, Amazon, Apple, Facebook. 

This year, however, the two top Chinese competitors also entered its top ten.Alibaba, Jack Ma's online trading giant, came in 9th after its brand value almost doubled to $ 113 billion. Alibaba's brand has been boosted by the company's expansion into areas such as mobile and cloud computing. 

Tencent, which last year entered the top 10 in the rankings last year, reached fifth place after its brand rose 65 percent to $ 179 billion. Tencent, which has instant messaging services, gaming applications and mobile payment services, has a market cap of $ 490 billion. In the rankings, it surpassed American giants like Facebook , ranked sixth with a brand value of $ 162 billion, and McDonald's, ranked eighth with $ 126 billion.

BrandZ's brand ranking is published annually by WPP's Canter Millward Brown. Google  was ranked first with a brand value of $ 302 billion - up 23% from last year - for the eighth time in the last 12 years. After Google are Apple , Amazon and Microsoft.        

Doreen Wang, who is responsible for BrandZ at Millward Brown, told CNN that the rating shows that Tencent and Alibaba have overcome many of China's many obstacles and become world powers. "The challenges facing Chinese brands are by no means small," she said. "The limited awareness of these brands in the international market, the lack of confidence due to quality problems in the past, and the reluctance of Chinese brands to invest in influential global campaigns have left them at a disadvantage compared with the more established competitors."However, China's rise and the awakening of young and conscious consumers have created opportunities for smart entrepreneurs, she said. "The attitudes are changing, especially among young consumers who fall in love with Chinese brands," she said. "Although the penetration into the US market is still in the initial stages of the two brands, other regions embrace them warmly."

According to a new Wall Street Journal study, these are issue documents copied from other locations, false promises about the amount of return and false names of employees and founders; Investors have so far lost $ 273 million in suspicious issues.

photo source: pexels  

ICO, or initial currency issue, has become a major buzzword in the past year. Many companies have begun to entertain the idea of

bypassing funds and investors and raising capital through the issue of currency Crypto. But as far as it seems easy to implement, a study by the Wall Street Journal showed Thursday that at least 271 out of 1,450 (almost 20 percent) ICO issues showed investors clear signs of fraud or at least missing critical information. In 111 cases, researchers found that the documents copied verbatim descriptions or paragraphs published in previous issue documents.

The signs begin to appear in investors' documents copied from other sources, with promises of return on investment and names of fake employees and founders, or even not listed in the white paper. In a particular case, the researchers found that in the issuance documents for a company called Denaro, which supposedly set up an online payments platform, the founder, one named Jeremy Boker, was an invented figure. The company's IPO yielded $ 8.3 million, and it is not clear whether they will ever return to their owners.
 

The picture of Boker was copied from a free-images site, and there is no proof that there ever was such a person. The rest of the team was invented. This is only one example, but in the field where more than $ 1 billion was invested in the 271 suspicious issues found by the researchers last year, this is a very worrisome phenomenon.


 
photo source: pexels 

 A cumulative loss of over a quarter of a billion dollars
So far, it has been found that investors have lost a total of $ 273 million in these projects, according to claims documents or regulatory actions. It should be noted that the number of issuance's worldwide is much higher than those surveyed by the researchers. The study focused on issues that were intended for investors in English-speaking countries since 2014. According to the calculation, the 1,450 issues raised so far raised a total of $ 5 billion from investors. Since 2017, the issues of Crypto Coins have yielded about $ 9 billion in profits worldwide, according to a study by Satis Corporation. This is a field that worries regulators around the world. The US Securities and Exchange Commission has already warned investors that many of these issues are illegal. Last Wednesday, the ISA launched a website designed to show how a website that publishes a fake ICO issue appears. The warning signs include hiding or falsifying the names of the employees or founders, a promise of return or return without risk - that is contrary to US Securities Authority rules or even a promise of a weekly refund or a doubling of earnings. An example of this was revealed last year when PlexCorps managed to raise $ 15 million by promising a yield of 1,354%. In December, all its assets were frozen by court order but according to its Facebook page it was still active at the end of April. 

photo source: pexels

 
Photos of dubious origin

Interest in the issue of ICO arose due to the increase in the value of crypto currencies such as Bitcoin or Ethereum. Similarly, these issues are not regulated or required to comply with certain rules or other. This requires investors to be more careful and even carry out research and forensic research. Former executives in the field of financial regulation explained that although this is a field in which legitimate companies will operate, in the end, the majority will turn out to be fraudulent. The writing of issuance documents now costs about $ 100 on average and today there is a whole market of freelancers who will be happy to provide you with the same quality. In some cases, the images used were of dubious origin. For example, in the case of Premium Trade, a start-up led by two companies: Andrew Ravitzky and Idan Cohen, the CEO, it turns out that the photos they published were drawn from the Stock Photo sites, and the main developer Ram Rosenfeld presented a picture that appeared on other sites. Available for comment. Another case concerns LoopX, which has promised to set up the leading trading platform for the crypto-currency market. Her documents did not detail her technology or who the staff and founders were. Moreover, some of the material in the documents was copied directly from other projects. After announcing that it had raised about $ 4.5 million, LoopX disappeared. Her website was deleted and the Twitter account she used now includes a single link to the news that the founder took the money and ran with it.  

It is not clear when the regulators will come to their senses and begin to act to increase supervision over these issues. In many cases, this is a method that was found by shady entrepreneurs to raise money from unsuspecting or misunderstood investors. In the end, these are small amounts of money that accumulate into huge amounts. It is important to remember that in any such issue, the information provided is not bound by any rule, so if you are interested in investing in a company that is trying to raise capital through ICO, the recommendation is to examine each and every detail and assume that if something does not look serious, it probably indicates fraud.

GIA is an international gemological institute based in the United States but has branches worldwide. Diamantaires around the world send the diamonds to receive a GIA certificate which will detail the diamond's qualities that determine its value. Diamonds with GIA certificates are considered to be of a higher standard, since the Institute is considered very strict and its grading processes are rigorous. In addition to being a gemology institute, AAA maintains colleges, magazines and research and is an authority for diamond knowledge. 

Did you know?Almost all the gemological institutes are called in the name of 3 foreign letters: EGL, IGI, HRD, IGL, GCI, and so many are confused between the various institutes. When in fact GIA is the most considered. 

The advantages of buying GIA-certified diamonds are prominent and mainly:

  1. The diamond is tested before being placed in the world's most rigorous lab.
  2. GIA is an international laboratory with branches around the world and is therefore recognized and traded worldwide.
  3. Usually there is an engraving of the certificate number on the diamond belt that makes it easier to identify.
  4. A GIA certificate is considered "negotiable" and if you wish to trade in the future, it will make it easier for you to trade

The disadvantage of purchasing GIA-certified diamonds:

These transactions are usually higher, since the long process of testing the laboratory and the worsening of the results increase the product to the end customer. If your total budget is less than 5,000 NIS, it is not certain that jewelry with GIA-certified diamonds is for you.

Which diamonds will have a GIA certificate?

GIA certified diamonds can be found in the market starting from 0.30 carats, but these certificates are more popular for diamonds of half-carats or more.

Safe and correct buying tips:

1. Purchase only merchants who have a "diamond trade license". An example of a trade license can be seen on the side, so be sure to buy from the source for diamonds and from an authorized dealer with a diamond trade license from the Ministry of Industry and therefore subject to Israel's diamond trading laws.

2. The GIA Certificate is a hard cardboard certificate that is available in shades of ivory and gold and is available in two sizes. Examples of GIA certificates can be seen below. We have already heard of cases where customers received a photocopy of a certificate, a print from the GIA site of a certificate copy, or a certificate from another lab with a similar name. 

3. Buying diamonds is a serious business - insist on receiving an invoice. Would you consider buying an apartment from a contractor or a vehicle from an importer without an invoice? When you are tempted to make an unlisted cash transaction and save your VAT, you are actually waiving all your consumer rights.  No other document has been accepted in a consumer court other than an invoice.

4. Be sure to purchase the jewelry set with a diamond bearing a GIA certificate, and not the diamond without a ring so that they can not claim that "replacing" a diamond.

5. After placing the ring, ask the place where you sold the ring to check the diamond engraving with a microscope - so you can make sure that the diamond matches the certificate you purchased.

Is the origin of a diamond really important? Today we have reached the point where it is possible to create diamonds in laboratory conditions, which are almost indistinguishable from natural diamonds, for millions of years. 

image source: pexels

Although synthetic diamonds they are only a quarter of a percent of the world's $ 80 billion diamond market , the growing demand for cheaper, bloodless diamonds (as has happened in many African countries) has led the diamond market to develop in the direction of laboratory production. If you are debating whether to buy an artificial diamond ring and what is the difference between it and a natural diamond - here are some things to know.

What is the difference between a diamond and a zircon?

A synthetic diamond is not zircon. Everyone knows Cubic Zircon, one of the most famous diamond imitations in the world. Zircon is an imitation that looks like a diamond, but lacks the chemical composition of a diamond. Other gemstones that mimic diamonds are classified as imitations, while others - imitations of lesser value - are, for example,moissanite , quartz and glass. Unlike imitation diamonds, gemstones and laboratory-grown diamonds have physical and chemical properties that are completely identical to the real thing . Diamonds are made of carbon grating, but in this case the carbon block is placed in a powerful oven that allows it to grow into a diamond within a few days.

Image source: pexels
 

It is almost impossible to distinguish between an artificial diamond and a natural one

Even a professional look can hardly distinguish between the two types (although there are indeed gemological differences between the two). Synthetic gems contain the same physical and chemical properties as natural gemstones that have been mined from the ground. Synthetic diamonds are also called in other names such as laboratory diamonds, manmade diamonds and more.

Artificial diamond is cheaper

Although the prices of diamonds vary according to parameters such as shape, cut, carat, clarity and color, diamonds average 20 to 30 percent less than natural diamonds, according to Stephen Lux - CEO Gemesis diamond company company - manufacturer of laboratory diamonds. for example: 0.50 carat diamond can cost between $ 500 to $ 2,500, while the price of 1 carat diamond will range from $ 2,000 to $ 8,000.  many now choose to purchase engagement rings or wedding band with full knowledge that the lower price would not have any effect on the glittering prestige.
 

image source: pexels 

Not everything is pink (or yellow, or blue ...)

One of the main drawbacks of artificial diamonds is the size limit that can be reached in the laboratory. This may be a purely technological matter, depending on the equipment available to the manufacturer. Some manufacturers sell translucent, colorless diamonds in sizes of half to one and a half carats, but their colored diamonds come in larger sizes. Another drawback is a more philosophical matter - an artificial diamond is created within a few days, while natural diamond is created over millions of years. Less romantic, in the humble minds of some people.
 

Image source: pexels

Create a diamond in 10 weeks instead of millions of years

Those who still do not mind the differences between a natural and artificial diamond will be happy to know that you can also grow diamonds at home using the do-it-yourself method. So how do you grow diamonds?1. Place a carbon block in a strong microwave oven containing methane or other gas containing carbon.2.  The carbon block is heated with high intensity until it becomes a hot, glowing plasma ball.3.  In this state, the carbon particles undergo a process of crystallization until they become diamonds; A process that can take up to 10 weeks.
The current technology has developed so much that today even gem and gem experts  need a machine to tell them whether they are gemstones from a laboratory or gemstones extracted from the earth. An article on this subject: Gemological characteristics that distinguish between natural and synthetic . Today's young people are less concerned about whether the diamond came under or above the ground, 45 percent of consumers aged 18 to 35 in North America said they preferred natural diamonds. In 2013, the diamond industry created artificial diamonds totaling only 360,000 carats , compared to 146 million carats for natural diamonds, according to research firm Frost and Sullivan. The forecast is that in 2018 this number will jump to 2 million, and in 2026 to 20 million. De Beers' research department has shown that consumers do not compare natural and synthetic diamonds . The value of a diamond is inevitably linked to its underlying narrative - from the way it creates a continuation of its history to its emotional importance; Elements that lab diamonds usually do not include, according to a statement by De Beers. Not just the International Standards Organization ruled that manmade gemstones would be called Synthetic, Lab grown or Lab created - and not real, cultured or cultivated. IIA Technologies in Singapore is pricing in a synthetic diamond of 3.04 carats for $ 23,000, compared with a natural gem of the same size and weight that will cost about $ 40,000. "We are creating a new industry," said Vishal Mehta, the company's CEO, who is not willing to reveal how much it costs to create a diamond in a laboratory. "Today's consumers are aware of this and prefer a selection of environmentally friendly diamonds to humans.

three years ago the mystery of the blue / gold dress drove the net. The world on its surfers was divided into two. Those who saw the dress in blue and white, and those who saw it in white gold. 

 
Various proposals were proposed then to resolve the contradiction. Some focused on the direction of optical illusion.But now, a new trend is driving the surfers crazy. This time he no longer speaks with the sense of sight that can easily be imagined. The ears seem to be harder to cheat. Who ever heard of an "auditory delusion"? It all began with a Twitter user named Chloe Feldman who brought up the short audio clip, with the simple question "What do you hear, Yanny or Laurel? "This video here has already received 2 million views in less than 24 hours, not including copied videos for hundreds already distributed across social media. (In this latest YouTube video, you'll find Chloe's explanation and documentation herself, a successful autobiography). 



https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EXRoQGHx-80

— Cloe Feldman (@CloeCouture) May 15, 2018

What do you hear?! Yanny or Laurel pic.twitter.com/jvHhCbMc8I 

Click here to view Twitter

The data of millions of Facebook users who used the popular  "myPersonality"  application, including their answers to intimate question, remained exposed and accessible to everyone on the Web.

The University of Cambridge distributed the data from the puzzle app to hundreds of researchers through the Web site without adequate security instructions, leaving them easy to access illegally for four years.This is very private information that reveals personal information of Facebook users such as psychological testing results. The information was supposed to be confidential but insufficient precautions were taken and user information was easy to recover.Facebook suspended "myPersonality" on April 7 and said that the app violated its policies by describing how to store information in the app and on the site.More than six million people performed the tests on "myPersonality" and about half agreed to share data such as age, gender, relationship information, statuses, and more from their Facebook profile with the project. All information was collected and user names removed before being uploaded to the site for use by the researchers. The terms of use allow the "myPersonality" Team to use and share the information "anonymously so that the information can not be attributed back to the private user." 


"myPersonality" was not just an academic project. Investigators from commercial companies were also allowed to access the data as long as they agreed to follow a strict procedure for protecting the information and did not directly benefit from it. In order to access the full data, the researchers were required to register as collaborators in the project. 

More than 280 people from almost 150 institutions have done so, including researchers at universities and companies like Facebook , Google, Microsoft and Yahoo.But for those who were not entitled to access, such as people without a regular academic contract, it was easy to get around the problem by using an active username and password that was available in a simple web search and anyone who wanted to access the data could find the username and password and download the material in less than a minute.The data was controlled by David Stillwell and Michal Kosinski at Cambridge University's Psychometric Center and Alex Kogan of Cambridge Analytics who previously belonged to the project.

They actually sold access to a tool that allows targeting ads based on personality types built on the basis of collected data. What was described as "the reader of public opinion"Facebook began investigating "MyPersonality" as part of a broader investigation of applications that used its platform. It began with claims about access to information from another application by Cambridge Analytics.Today, Facebook announced that it has suspended about 200 applications as part of its investigation of applications that have accessed extensive user information. "We are now examining the application and if they refuse to cooperate with us, we will block them," the vice president of product partnerships said on Facebook.The application site has been removed, important that Twitter has been closed and no access to this information is currently available.

Cambridge University says that the application was created by Steewell before joining the university and he did not get their approval, the University of Cambridge does not own and does not control the application or data.In response to our inquiry, Stilwell said that during the nine years of the project there was only one loophole, and that the researchers who had access to the data had undertaken not to take action to discover users. "We believe that academic studies benefit from a controlled sharing of anonymous data among the research community." He also claims that it is a bit strange that Facebook, which is aware of his project and met with its partners since 2011, claims to have known nothing about the project and the security breach.

I know that most of the users in Steemit are from Indonesia, In the past, only Israeli businessmen could get to Indonesia and get a visa and their businesses had to do through Singapore, there was no possibility of doing business directly.

I am very happy to hear the following news I have found in an article in one of the newspapers!

"Vacation in Bali? The Israel-Indonesia Chamber of Commerce has recently reported progress in efforts to promote tourist visas to Israelis in the country, but there is still no final decision on the issue"

still no final decision on the issue, but i guess that it will happen soon!

 
Will Bali vacation packages be marketed to Israelis soon? The Israel- Indonesia Chamber of Commerce recently reported progress in efforts to promote tourist visas to Israelis in the country - but there is still no final decision on the subject. Israel has no diplomatic relations with Indonesia despite a slight warming in recent years. Emanuel Shahaf, chairman of the Chamber of Commerce, told Haaretz: "We hope that people in Indonesia who are trying to advance the thaw in relations will succeed soon."Indonesia , the country with the largest Muslim population in the world, is an island nation that enjoys many tourists coming to its shores, mainly from Australia and Japan. Although some travel agencies offer tourist packages to Israelis (mainly organized groups), they are very limited and expensive. 
 
 A beach near Indonesia's Komodo Nature Reserve in April ( Photo source  STAFF / Reuters )
 

 

STAFF / Reuters)

Will Bali vacation packages be marketed to Israelis soon? The Israel-Indonesia Chamber of Commerce recently reported progress in its efforts to promote tourist visas to Israelis in the country - but there is still no final decision on the matter. Israel has no diplomatic relations with Indonesia despite a slight warming in recent years. Emanuel Shahaf, chairman of the Chamber of Commerce, told Haaretz: "We hope that the people in Indonesia who are trying to advance the thaw in the relationship will succeed soon."Indonesia, the country with the largest Muslim population in the world, is an island nation that enjoys many tourists coming to its shores , mainly from Australia and Japan. Although some travel agencies offer tourist packages to Israelis (mainly organized groups), they are very limited and expensive.  

 https://youtu.be/rsntxZoBflE 

 A video of Lt. Col. Laurent Curtis, who visited her in Bali, Indonesia 

Indonesia is not officially recognized in Israel. However, since the Oslo Accords and more intensively in recent years, there has been a latent connection between the countries, which is becoming more and more restrictive, especially in the economic sphere. Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin visited Indonesia in 1993. Israeli businessmen can visit with a special non-tourist visa. In December 2013, the then Minister of Economy Naftali Bennett visited the Jewish home.The Singapore Ministry of Economic Affairs is also responsible for the connection with Indonesia, where in 2015 it reported a significant increase in trade, which totaled about $ 500 million a year, including imports of raw materials such as plastics, wood, coal, textiles and palm oil. Export was mainly in the fields of energy, water and technology. 

 Tourists photograph a volcano eruption in Indonesia, last year (Photo source   Lukman S. Bintoro / AFP)


 Hotel in Bali, Indonesia, 2013 (Photo source Bloomberg)

 In March 2016, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu declared at a meeting with Indonesian journalists in Israel that it was time to establish official relations with the state and said that "the reasons that prevented the change of relations are no longer relevant." He added: "I have quite a few Indonesian friends on Facebook."A few weeks earlier, Deputy Foreign Minister Tzipi Hotovely (Likud) revealed that Israel was holding secret contacts with Indonesia "in an effort to improve relations between the two peoples" and that "there was a visit by the head of the Asian department of the Foreign Ministry in Jakarta." Hotovely replied to the question about preventing Indonesia's foreign minister from entering the Palestinian Authority . The decision was made at the time because of its refusal to visit Jerusalem simultaneously and to meet with officials in the Israeli government. In an earlier Islamic summit in Jakarta, Indonesian President Joko Widodo said boycotts of products originating in "illegal Israeli settlements" in the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Golan Heights should be boycotted. 

 Orange-Otang monkeys in Indonesia, 2017 (Photo Source  Tim Laman / National Geographic )

 In 2017 reports began to be made of intention in Jakarta to add Israel to the list of countries whose citizens would not require a special visa to enter. The authorities denied this shortly afterwards.

Manufacturing jewelry in casting is a method that has existed for decades around the world. In contrast to the manufacture of handmade jewelry, it is possible to manufacture a large quantity of the same piece of jewelry exactly and market it at low prices and in large quantities. The development of this method caused an upheaval and shock in the jewelry world and transformed the jewelry from a rare and unique product into a cheap and available product for the entire population.
As each method has advantages and disadvantages, the main advantage is the large production capacity relative to the low cost, and the disadvantage of this method is the inability to reach thin thicknesses and combine two types of gold in the same casting.

https://steemitimages.com/DQmcNdcEVbP94VLUhtdSBwaHvatsCV5XmcPuWXcoBUEWLd2/WeChat%20Screenshot_20180508192431.png

The stages of production in the preparation of jewelry in casting - the method of invisible wax.

1. Preparation of the prototype "Master"
The first stage is the preparation of the desired model, with pre-planning of the jewel for this method. In order for the jewelry to be prepared in a cast, a 1.5 cm rod must be added to the base of the jewel and used for the injection stages of the wax and the gold or silver in the casting stage. The face of the jewelry should be especially smooth since any scratch or protrusion on the prototype will appear in all the cast jewelry.

https://steemitimages.com/DQmTWgkTGWQbtT31ar3xenj8e5pf82NZQm9sRhK9bm2k13R/WeChat%20Screenshot_20180508192035.png

2. Prepare a rubber mold.
The prototype is supplied to a rubber cutter whose job it is to make a special rubber mold while designing its inner space according to the shape of the jewelry and the foundry. The rubber used by the rubber cutter is a special type of rubber that melts in the high heat and fits perfectly into the jewelry. For rubber smelting there are special aluminum molds that are adapted to a special vulcanizing device that warms the mold in which the jewelry and rubber are placed. After the heating and rubber smelting process has finished, refrigerate the molds and remove the rubber mold from which the jewelry is placed. At this stage, the rubber cutter cuts the rubber in its center using a surgical knife, using a special and professional method, and divides the rubber mold in two so that it can be pulled out of the mold without damaging the mold. After removing the jewelry from the mold, the rubber pattern remains in the shape of the jewel.

3. Preparation of wax cuttings in the shape of a jewel.
The third step is to make copies of the jewelry (prototype) in wax. For this purpose there is a metal boiler attached to an air compressor. In the boiler there is wax dissolved in high heat liquid, at the bottom of the boiler is a mouth shaped like a dish. When pressure is pressed, pressure wax is injected. The pattern which was divided by cutting rubber bands for connected back strongly between two aluminum panels sized pattern for the purpose of tightening the two parts of the mold.
When the female model made in the model is composed pole was about 1.5 cm in length, while cutting rubber creates cutter and nozzle cone connect through a point This is injected pressure into the mold. After the wax cools and hardens, carefully open the pan and remove the wax that has received the shape of the jewel - the prototype with the rod attached to it.

https://steemitimages.com/DQmY6eSTmCti78sSMReftzJrLmyuguj5nyuPzBPHPD6uU7p/WeChat%20Screenshot_20180508192451.png

4. Preparation of wax wood.
After making a large quantity of wax in the form of jewelry, the wax is wrapped around me. A thick wax pole in the shape of a round wood is reminiscent of the fir tree, hence the nickname "wax tree". The wood is inserted into a wax roll on a rubber base. A special liquid gypsum mixture is poured into the cylinder for casting that can withstand high temperatures. This plaster mixture fills each cavity in the cylinder and perfectly wraps the wood wax. After filling the cylinder with liquid wax, the cylinder is transferred to the solidification stage of the cast in a controlled manner with the vibration device designed to remove air bubbles from the cast.

5. Remove the wax from the cylinder with the cast.
After an initial solidification of the cast, the cylinder is separated from the rubber base and placed in a special oven whose function is to heat the cylinder with the cast and the wax to a high temperature in which the wax returns to the liquid state and exits the cylinder. After all the wax had left the Galilee, the plaster remained hollow in the shape of the wax tree - the shape of the jewels. At this stage, the cylinder is transferred to an oven in which the cast is heated to a temperature of 750 degrees Celsius in a slow and controlled manner for about 12 hours.

https://steemitimages.com/DQmQJ14ewhWRR1Y5BKB2qtpCjNonkfrGHkUL1ifYgHGKKia/WeChat%20Screenshot_20180508192423.png

6. Foundry phase.
After the cast reaches the desired heat, transfer the cylinder to a vacuum casting machine or centrifuge machine. As a melting pot, pour the silver or gold into a liquid state and pour it into the cylinder with the cast inside the casting machine.
There are two casting methods, the vacuum method or the centrifuge method. The two methods are intended to completely fill the cavities created in the cast and create identical jewelry for a prototype.

7. Dismantling the wood from silver or gold.
After a relative cooling of the cylinder filled with plaster and silver or gold, the plaster is broken with water pressure and the identical jewelry is discovered.

8. Finish the jewel.
What is left is to separate the jewelry from the tree and move them to final finishing stages.

https://steemitimages.com/DQmTcrQTKXxpswmvs4gTaJvA8e5Tb9ee1177RRrFZCzRevv/TB2ybO5nYSYBuNjSspiXXXNzpXa_!!163204554.jpg Thanks for reading i hope your'e like it! sorry about my english i use translete with some word that i dont know i hope its quality enough
