op.body:
In this post I will present pictures from the last week from around the world

Enjoy 👌 


Texas, USA

A border guard kidnaps a woman after she illegally crossed into the United States from Mexico near McAllen.

Juarez, Mexico

A boy from the Anpara region watches bi-national prayers at the border between Ciudad Juarez and Sonland Park, New Mexico.

Juarez, Mexico

A man turns his horse from fire after a fire broke out from a pile of old tires in a recycling center in Ciudad Juarez.

Caro, Indonesia

Lightning hits the Sinabung volcano in Caro. Sinabung erupted in 2010 for the first time in 400 years. The volcano erupted again in 2013 and it has remained very active ever since.

The Indian Ocean

A sonar image published by the Australians shows a wrecked ship on the bottom of the Indian Ocean. A four-year search failed to locate Malaysia Airlines 370 flights, but the search for the missing plane may be close to solving two mysteries of the 19th century: the location of two sailboats that disappeared while carrying coal. Marine historians have published a short list of possible identities of two shipwrecks found during the initial search of 710,000 sq km for the Boeing 777 lost in 2014 with 238 people on board.

Belarus

A contestant competes in the obstacle course competition on a ski site.

Tel Aviv Israel

Prime Minister Netanyahu in exposing the Iranian nuclear archive.

Berlin Germany

Demonstrators lighting fireworks on a roof overlooking a demonstration against capitalism in Berlin on the eve of May 1.

Madrid, Spain

Women shout during a demonstration against five men who have been acquitted of rape and convicted of a lesser offense of sexual abuse. The controversy has also stirred thousands of women sharing bad experiences of Twitter abuse under the #cuentalo tag (tell it).

Warsaw, Poland

The police are clashing with supporters of the radical nationalist camp, participating in the parade to show their opposition to left-wing politics and the labor movement.

Tegucigalpa, Honduras

Police stand outside the city's palace after protesters burned it during a demonstration demanding the resignation of President Juan Orlando.

Aden, Yemen

Um Mazra, 25, is holding her son at al-Sadaka Hospital. The woman, who is almost in her second trimester, suffers from a severe weight loss of only 38 kilograms, and a 17-month-old sperm weighs 5.8 kilograms, about half the normal weight of his age.

Paju, South Korea

Soldiers dismantle loudspeakers set up for propaganda broadcasts near the demilitarized zone that separates the two Koreas. South Korea silenced the huge loudspeakers issuing messages to the soldiers on the border, in a conciliatory gesture after the historic summit between the two Koreas.

Gul Dara, Afghanistan

Friends and relatives of the chief photographer of the Agence France-Presse in Afghanistan, Shah Marai Paisi, pray while they gather for his burial Marai, who left six children, was among at least nine journalists killed in suicide bombings in the Afghan capital. At least 16 people were killed in the explosions.

Bnei Brak, Israel

Religious children light bonfires on Lag BaOmer.

Hawaii, USA

The Kluyaia volcano is photographed from the air after it erupted after a series of earthquakes.

Portmag, Ireland

Holidaymakers are shooting baskets together with Star Wars fans on a boat during a festival opening trip.

Bangladesh

Bangladesh boats carrying watermelons on the Burigangan River, hundreds of suppliers from the village come to the capital Bangladesh to sell their fruits.

Moscow, Russia

Rehearsals for the 73rd day of victory over the Nazis on 9 May.

Netherlands

Newlyweds photographed in a field of colorful flowers.

St. Petersburg, Russia

Drumming in the city streets for the May 1st celebrations.

Stockholm, Sweden

Dogs are photographed under cherry trees in full bloom in the Kongstadradgarden in the center of Stockholm.

Damascus, Syria

Smoke rises from buildings during shelling in the Yarmuk refugee camp and the neighboring province of Al-Hajar al-Aswad, south of Damascus, Syria, on May 1.

Armenia

Supporters of Armenian opposition leader Nicole Fashinian attended the rally after parliament rejected his proposal as interim prime minister in the center of Yerevan, Armenia.

Sao Paulo, Brazil firemen work on the site of the remains of a 24-story building after collapsed due to a fire that broke out.

that's it! Hope to make such a post every week!

Hope you liked

@headcorner
op.title: This week around the world in pictures📸

The social network is currently looking into the possibility of a paid version without ads and advertisements following the scandal of violating the privacy of users.

 Protest against Facebook on the background of Mark Zuckerberg's hearing in CongressAARON P. BERNSTEIN / Reuters

Facebook conducted market research in recent weeks to determine whether users would be willing to pay for a social network version without ads and ads. In addition, sources familiar with the issue said, Facebook has tested whether such a version of subscribers will attract more users.Facebook has done research on the subject in the past, but now there is momentum and support for the company to create such a version - against the background of the privacy breach scandal that Facebook has been dealing with recently. However, there are still no ready-to-launch programs and this initiative may not be promoted, according to people familiar with the issue. Facebook declined to comment.Mark Zuckerberg, the CEO of Facebook, has long considered this possibility not as a replacement for Facebook's business model but as a factor that will prevent users from abandoning it, with nearly $ 41 billion in revenue from sales of targeted advertisements According to research conducted by the company in recent years, users will not respond positively to the subscription plan: if Facebook demands payment for a service that has always been free, they will see it as greedy. 

heryl Sandberg: If Facebook users want to avoid using their information - they will pay

Now, however, Facebook believes there has been a change in consumer attitudes. The company is facing a crisis of confidence after one of the Facebook application developers obtained information from millions of users and transferred it to Cambridge Analytics Analytics, a company that worked with political parties, including Trump's campaign in 2016. The affair caused concern that Facebook uses customer information in ways they did not expect and can not understand.The social network has conducted extensive testing to test its businesses and identify ways to tighten security on user information to restore consumer confidence and improve their network experience. The company has agreed to make far-reaching changes,  such as rating news sites according to their reliability and rating of user responses.In addition, the company's managers are faced with the difficult questions of employees wondering whether the social network should at all allow the publication of political ads. Cheryl Sandberg, Facebook's chief operating officer, said last month that the social network should continue to publish political ads to promote freedom of speech.Zuckerberg and Sandberg spent most of the conference call with analysts after the release of the first quarter of 2018 to explain why a business model that focuses on advertising revenue should be supported, arguing that this model makes it possible to reach a broader audience than any other socioeconomic status. "We are considering many options, including subscribers," said Sandberg, who said during a congressional hearing that he was open to the possibility of subscription service, "There will always be a free version of Facebook," Zuckerberg said.

Source: https://www.themarker.com/wallstreet/1.6054865 / Bloomberg
op.title: In the world Facebook's Secret Experiment: Are users willing to pay for a subscription?

God created the donkey and said to him: Be a donkey, work hard from sunrise to sunset, take your back from weights, eat grass, you won't be smart and you'il live 50 years. The donkey replied: "God Almighty, I'll be a donkey, but to live 50 years is too much, I'il settle for 20 years." 

After consideration what God has answered at the request of the donkey. 

After that, God created the dog and said to him: you will take care of the people, be your best friend, eat the leftovers that will give you and you will live 25 years. The dog sighed and replied: Lord of the World, I will be a dog, but to live 25 years as a dog is too much, I will settle for 10 years. 

God thought and answered his request the next day God created the ape and said to him: Be a monkey, jump from branch to branch, laugh the people and live for 20 years as a monkey thought the monkey and replied: Lord of the World I am ready to be a monkey but live 20 years as a monkey is too much, I would like you to take half of my life. 

Be considerate of God and have confirmed him 10 years of life. 

Finally, God created man and said to him: Be a man, master the intellect of all earth and use it to control the whole world and live 20 years replied to him: God Almighty I'm ready to be a man but live for 20 years is too little , please add the 30 years that the donkey and the rest, the 15 years that the dog did not want and the 10 years that the monkey had rejected. I would be pleased to be a person. 

Thought of God and so he did. 

And since man has lived for 20 years as a man, marries, receives a mortgage, brings children and works like a donkey for 30 years, when the children leave the house, he lives alone like a dog for 15 years and when he comes to retirement he lives 10 years as a monkey, jumps from home to the children's house and makes a fool of himself in order to make the grandchildren laugh in this reality of life...

op.author: headcorner
op.body:
The Taobao website, is the Chinese eBay (not owned by eBay), is the largest site in China, which is dominated by 70% of electronic commerce in China. Like the international eBay site, users of the Taobao site can sell and buy products, when the idea is based on a business model of C2C, customer to customer where any user can buy and sell new and used items, commercial quantities and services.

The site belongs to and is managed by Alibaba Group (Alibaba.com), gaining great popularity among internet users and consumers in China and is a significant phenomenon in modern and developed China. I wouldn't exaggerate if I said there is no internet user in China who does not know the Taobao site, which also serves as the first source of a price survey to purchase products of all kinds, even food.

Shopping Taobao

Shopping and personal imports from China are not a new phenomenon, there are quite a few sales sites, Chinese traders on eBay and vendors such as Alibaba which were the source of purchasing products directly from China. The Taobao site, which is designed for the local Chinese market and is operated in the Chinese language, has not been an option to be an efficient and quality source of product acquisition. While acquiring from various countries that have been exposed to the site on various occasions, and Chinese traders who have understood the enormous commercial potential of bringing the site to the international audience recently created a phenomenon of demand from the huge to shopping agents on the Taobao website.

A shopping agent is a middleman, provides a service that allows consumers from all over the world to do shopping on Taobao website for a commission. The shopping agent will assist in locating the product, negotiations in front of the seller, translation, payment, and international shipping of goods directly to the final consumer, all in the English language it cannot be found on the Chinese website.

So what is the advantage of Taobao site on other sites, or on the Alibaba website?

As I mentioned earlier, the Taobao site is a site where the traders sellers are users themselves, so when you do shopping on the site Taobao there are quite a few opportunities to purchase products marketed by private individuals. However, the Taobao site has other advantages over sites like Alibaba because the site is much more accessible to suppliers and factories in China where there are no employees who control good enough in the English language.

So you can find products to which it will be more difficult to reach through other acceptable sites. Also being of the site is based on retail sales, the availability of products is much higher than it is on the site Alibuba where a lot of "brokerage/" companies that do not actually hold in stock but represent factories. 

Many vendors who produce goods regularly to the Chinese market use the Taobau site as a main channel for marketing products to the Chinese audience, so you can also get a lot of products designed for the local audience that cannot be obtained anywhere else.


What can be bought in Taobao?

The products that can be bought on the Taobao site are all that can be bought from China, ranging from branded clothes, footwear, electronic products, computers, cell phones, accessories, toys, food and Chinese medicines and in short, and prices... Prices like in China!


How does TAOBAO shopping agent service work?

Tips and important information you should know before you start shopping in Taobao:

The first stage is of course locating an agent Taobao that will be able to give you a reliable and quality service in the price level that will leave the positive experience also worthwhile. The criteria to meet a high quality agent Tao:

1. Controlling the English language

2. Email, instant messaging software, chat on site

3. The ability to make deliveries in a variety of ways, including air mail from Hong Kong or Singapore. (cheapens costs)

4. Service fee not exceeding 10% 15% of the transaction's height

5. Receipt of payments in PayPal

6. Recommendations from familiar friends or forums

7. Working under the supervision and management of Western. recommended !!

It is recommended to start with small orders to accept the orders, and continue from there.

Anyone who wants to purchase through the site can help! I have a very reliable friend who can help with shipping for 15% of the transaction

And everyone has an opening condition how much better than your lame offer. Wouldn't it be a shame to lose the fee? It's like throwing money in the trash.


Successful: The past is full of people who walked against the current, who went against all odds and succeeded.


Loser: Who do you mean? For individuals who must have had conditions that allowed them in the first place to succeed, or did they happen to be successful?


Successful: I necessarily talk about those who had no conditions, yet...


Loser: Is that what you think? How naïve you are. People like to exaggerate and say that they have had a hard time doesn't mean that it was really. People like to make drama of everything.


Successful: Let's take Addison for example. He made a thousand attempts until he succeeded.


Loser: How many adisons have?? One besides, he must have had a rich father, and he himself didn't have much to do in life. I have enough to do with my life.


Let's take Michael Jordan.


Loser: Sure! It is tall and muscular. Not everyone has a body like that. Besides, he must have been born with talent.


Successful: He was not born with talent. He just practiced a lot.


Loser: That's what he tells. Do you know how many people are practicing, and yet they are not approaching their level?


Successful: Were they training like him?


Loser: Not just like him, but invest.


Successful: Let's take Abraham Lincoln.


Loser: Not everyone can be president of the USA. Need certain conditions for that. If it was that easy, tomorrow I would be prime minister.


Successful: So we take Oprah Winfrey.


Loser: probably helped her. Don't believe everything you're told. ? Besides, some of these guys must have been lucky.


Successful: Luck plays for people who do and believe they will succeed.


Loser: There is nothing to do with the action. You can do and believe, but in the end it won't work.


Successful: It is true that even if you do and believe, it does not require that you get the result you want, but when you do and believe, the chances of greater success than if you do not at all.


Loser: Listen, you're exhausting me. ? How would you like to be realistic I will not take a chance with something that the chances of succeeding in them are slim.


Successful: So what do you prefer, stay where you are?


Loser: At least I don't make fun of myself. . I'm a realist. I don't live in La La Land. Sometimes a person should use a healthy logic. Not just inventing the concept: common sense.


Successful: At least you're ready to answer now to the phone that's been under your elbow and ringing for a long time?


Loser: Probably some nag looking to interrupt. Okay, i'il answer for you...


(Ends the call on the phone):


HAVE!!!! We managed!!!!. Got our project. We're going to be millionaires!!!! Have!!! Have!!!


Now, say, when did you get the project?    

       

Successful: While you were talking about being realistic, and give explanations/"rationality" Why shouldn't you submit the project...

The last idea, the one I sent to them during our "Helpful/" conversation, they loved so much that they could not wait and were ringing to announce that they received my offer.


Morality:


To succeed, you will use determination and devotion to the purpose.


Even if he didn't go at first, go on! Use other ways until you can.


Believe you will succeed! Faith will help you cope with others who are unfaithful, who use resources to "prove" you are making a mistake, which should not be lost, etc.

The professor began the lesson by lifting a cup with a little water. He held the glass to make sure everyone saw her and asked the students: "How much do you think this glass weighs?"


"50 gram!"... "100 grams!" 125 g!... Respond to the students.


I really don't know. In order to know how much she considers me to consider it. ' said the professor. 

"But my question is: what will happen if I hold the cup for a few minutes?"


"Nothing." The students said, "What happens if I hold the glass like this for an hour?" asked the professor.


"Your hand will start to hurt," said one of the students.


It's true. And what happens if I hold the glass for a day?


"Your hand may hataben, you may feel a strong strain in your muscles and perhaps paralysis and you will probably have to be admitted to hospital," said another student and all the students laughed.


"Very good." But all this time, has there been a change in the weight of the glass? "asked the professor.


No... Was the answer.


"So what caused the pain in the arm and the muscle tension?"


The students were embarrassed.


"What should I do in order to be released from Achavim?" asked the professor.


"Put down the glass," said one of the students.


' That's right! ' said the professor. 

"Similarly, they are the problems of life." Hold them for a few minutes in your head and it looks pretty good. Think of them for a long time and you start to feel pain. If you continue much longer, they start to paralyze you. There will be no staff to do anything. It is important to think about the challenges or problems in your life, but what is more important is to leave them at the end of every day before you go to sleep. So you don't get nervous, wakes up every morning, fresh and strong, and can handle any challenge, every subject that ratsor your way!


Well, please, my friend, remember to put down the glass today!

"Gosh Dan" is completely jammed, after 22 mm Rain fell In an hour in Tel aviv. Videos from Rishon Lezion were seen cars and motorcycles disappear under water. Wood collapsed, vehicles damaged. Negba was measured 50 mm in two hours. 

Until the early afternoon it was another regular rain day. Some sprinkles, some streams flooded in the south. But in the last few hours, the day of rain has become a fearsome storm, a storm that also took at least one victim-a boy of 16 of the Bedouin diaspora that swept through a real stream. In the area of Gush Dan traffic overloads were particularly heavy, after one hour of about 22 mm rain in Tel Aviv, including a heavy hail. According to Waze, a trip from Rishon LeZion to Tel Aviv takes no less than two hours. Tell us in the Red Mile and in the response system how long it took you to travel during the storm.

After the earlier one went heavy in Dimona and in Arad and caused damages to vehicles, in the afternoon the Storm reached the center – with the damages. Large floods were caused in Tel Aviv, Rehovot, Kiryat Malachi and many other communities. Rishon LeZion was perhaps the focus. A video from the city looks like a great flood that completely eliminates a motorcycle. The Rothschild Mall in the city was completely flooded by the storm and children were extracted from a shelter hotzf at the Yadlin school in the city. Jabotinsky Street in the city was closed for movement in both directions following the road's flood.

According to the meteorological Service data, within an hour only (from 16:00 to 17:00), the Tel Aviv-22 mm rain and the nearby grain house, 16 mm. were measured 36 mm in the West Negev, 15 mm in Ashkelon and 9 mm in Jerusalem. Negba also fell 15 mm in the same time, in Be'er Sheva, 7 mm, and in Arad 5. In addition, the strong winds have caused a collapse of trees in different places. Due to the flooding of Highway 40, the south was blocked from Mitzpe Ramon Junction to Tzihor in both directions. Highway 90 was blocked from Ketura Junction to the Arava junction. In one of the Shizafon pictures, a tank that was drowned in a huge puddle was seen.

The storm also led to a sacrifice in the soul. Case Alhoashla, a 16-year-old Bedouin diaspora in the south, was swept through a real stream, drowned and died. At 15:20, a report was reported at the Mt. Negev extraction Unit for fear of his life. It swept a few hundred meters from the real National Park, adjacent to his home, a Bedouin tent of the tribe of Alawashla.

The boy was spotted inside the ravine, about three kilometers from the approximate point where he disappeared. His body was identified in one of the river's twists. The boy is extracted from the gurney to a stretcher and then turns in an Air force helicopter. His relative involved in the search found the body and called in the rescue unit. Duvi Roll, a volunteer in the Har HaNegev rescue unit, said that after the boy had been found, there was no resuscitation but to determine his death with the arrival of the medical team.

At the same time, they were evacuated from a stream near the Nokdim village in southern 37 boys and girls and six adults, after the bus they were riding was drifting. They were evacuated to Soroka hospital. Prof. David Greenberg, chairman of the Pediatrics department at Soroka, said that "all the evacuees had a medical assessment, all in a light condition." Some of them suffer from anxiety, and some are light bruises in the extremities. They are treated by pediatricians, orthopedic and surgeons according to their condition and accompanied by social workers.

 The difficulties of leaving a social media platform with two billion users 

By Maija Palmer 


Mark Zuckerberg’s not wholly reassuring testimony before the US Senate did little to placate angry users wondering whether they should #DeleteFacebook. But where to go if you leave a social media platform with two billion users, close to a third of the world’s population?  While a friend of mine opted for full social media cold turkey, most aren’t ready to kick the habit completely. The cool kids deserted Facebook for Instagram and WhatsApp some time ago but, as these are both owned by Facebook, they don’t feel like a genuine alternative for those worried about Zuckerberg’s reach into their lives.  A truly different social media experience probably requires a different business model. As we now know: if the service is free, you are not the customer but the product. Twitter, Snapchat and others operate on the same advertising-led model as Facebook and are vulnerable to the same problems.  To make sure our data is not being harvested we might — gulp — have to face paying for social media use. So what are the options? Vero began as a competitor to Instagram in 2015, gaining traction with users who liked posts appearing in their news feed chronologically rather than ordered by an algorithm. Earlier this year, numbers began a steep rise from 200,000 to more than four million, with many of these switching from Instagram.  Founder Ayman Hariri has said a paid model will make it clear to customers that they, not advertisers, are in charge. As the billionaire son of Lebanon’s late former prime minister, he may have more scope to experiment with this than most. But in the prevailing climate, ethical consumers demand good behaviour as well as good business plans. As Vero’s numbers rose, allegations surfaced of mistreated workers at Saudi Oger, the construction company that was the source of Hariri’s wealth, although the 39-year-old has said that he had left the company before the incidents in question.  Idka, based in Sweden, is another subscription-based option. Barely launched when the Cambridge Analytica story broke, it has seen a rush of interest over the past few weeks. Goran Wagstrom, chief executive, says: “Suddenly we are getting visitors from different countries, particularly the US.” He says customers spend time carefully reading the company’s terms and conditions, perusing Idka’s promise of absolute data privacy.  The Hosfelt Gallery in San Francisco, which had about 4,500 Facebook likes, is among those that have now switched to Idka. “Continuing to participate in Facebook . . . condones their unethical behaviour,” says founder Todd Hosfelt.  Idka prices start from €2 a month. But if paying for social media is unpalatable, what about a model that pays users when they post? Steemit pays users in a cryptocurrency called Steem as they produce content. It can be traded in blockchain markets for conventional currency and has a value of about $3 a unit. The company says it has paid out $22.7m to users since June 2016.  With 13 million unique visits in January, the platform is ad-free; no need to sell users’ eyeballs while the company makes money from the rising value of its stock of digital tokens. “It would be good if we could keep it that way,” says co-founder Ned Scott. The untried blockchain model may worry some, however, and the content of the site feels a little niche.  All three platforms are still tiny and will need to grow quickly to survive — a social media platform only works if your friends are there. A pivotal number of users is 100 million. It took Facebook four years to reach that. Even briefly popular sites such as MySpace peaked at about 100 million.  Challengers don’t seem to be worrying Facebook yet; in his Senate testimony, Zuckerberg struggled to name one competitor. After all, rivals to Facebook have tried and failed over the years. Remember Ello? Secret? Mastodon?  But trust in Facebook has fallen dramatically, according to a recent study by the Ponemon Institute. Now, if ever, people might be ready to try something new.  

Maija Palmer is the deputy editor of FT Special Reports
op.title: Are there any viable alternatives to Facebook?

 22 EU countries announced the establishment of a partnership in Blockchain ● The Bitcoin climbed for the first time this month above $ 7,600On Tuesday, 22 EU member states announced the establishment of the European Blockchain Partnership. According to the announcement by the European Commission (EC), the partnership will serve as a basis for cooperation between its member countries for the exchange of information and expertise in the technological and regulatory fields related to Blockchain technology, as part of the creation of a common digital market for EU countries.
The announcement of the Blocchien partnership followed the establishment of the European Union's Blockbaine Forum in February. The Commission has announced that it has already invested more than 80 million euros in projects supporting the use of Blockchein in technical and social fields. According to her, another 300 million euros will be allocated to projects in the field until 2020.Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Latvia, Luxembourg, Malta, Holland, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden and the United Kingdom.Lockchine is the software technology that came into being with the invention of Bitcoin at the end of 2008, on which most of the existing digital currencies are based. BlockCine creates a distributed database shared by a peer to peer network without a central server. The information in this technology is kept encrypted and transparent on the computers of the participants in the network, with the data recorded in a structure defined as a chain of blocks (hence the name Blokhian). Each block in this digital chain can be likened to a decentralized ledger page that is shared by all network participants and synchronized between them.Hundreds of enterprises around the world are developing platforms or applications of Blockkin technology. According to a study conducted last year at the Cambridge Business School, whose results were also published by "Globes", most of the applications currently active in the Blockkin area focus on financial services. However, entrepreneurs in the field are drawing increasing attention to other non-financial applications, such as digital identity, supply chain and intellectual property.Bitcoin rose 10% in the last 24 hours
According to the European Commission's announcement this week, one of the goals of the partnership was to prepare for the launch of the EU's Blochein applications for both the public and private sectors. The Commission noted that "this move should ensure that Europe continues to play a leading role in the development of the Blochein technologies."
"In the future, all public services will be using Blocchien technology," said Maria Gabrielle, EU's digital economy commissioner, "which enables member countries to work with the European Commission to tap the huge potential of technology to better serve citizens."The Crypto market, which includes more than 1,500 types of digital currency, is now valued at about $ 300 billion, down 65 percent from its peak of $ 830 billion in early 2018. Bitcoin climbed for the first time since Thursday April, above $ 7,600, after rising 10% in the past 24 hours. However, the current price of the Bitcoin is more than 60% below its peak in mid-December.Despite the market downturn, many companies around the world, including Israeli companies, are investing in blockcane-related projects, most of which are earmarked for finance. As we recently reported in "Globes", at the end of March, the Israeli Blockchain Forum was established as a joint framework for Israeli companies dealing with Blockchain technology, whose goal is to represent them vis-à-vis regulatory bodies and the government. According to Yigal Nevo, the director of the local forum, "The forum deals with promoting a binding ethical code for the Blockchain industry and creating a comprehensive set of rules. In addition, it works to promote technological, legal and business research in the field. "The forum is organized as a non-profit public benefit organization.

On April 22, over one billion people worldwide will celebrate the anniversary of World Earth Day. World communities from Beijing to Cairo, from Melbourne to London, from Madrid to Johannesburg, and Mario to New York will announce their concern for Earth, and call for action to save the planet.

The original goal of Earth Day in 1970 was to make people show caring and concern for the environment, so that the issue will be on the government's agenda. The event became a national demonstration held every year in the United States to highlight the importance of the environment.

The Earth Day is celebrated every year throughout the world.

In previous years, the "Earth Hour" activity was observed today, in which entire cities were eroded, with an emphasis on saving energy.

 End Plastic Pollution
Earth Day 2018 Campaign
From poisoning and injuring marine life to disrupting human hormones, from littering our beaches and landscapes to clogging our waste streams and landfills, the exponential growth of plastics is now threatening the survival of our planet.In response, Earth Day 2018 will focus on fundamentally changing human attitude and behavior about plastics and catalyzing a significant reduction in plastic pollution. Our strategy to End Plastic Pollution will: 
Lead and support the adoption of a global framework to regulate plastic pollution
Educate and mobilize citizens across the globe to demand action from governments and corporations to control and diminish plastic pollution
Inform and activate citizens to take personal responsibility for the plastic pollution that each one of us generates by choosing to reject, reduce, reuse and recycle plastics
Work with universities, school teachers and students to End Plastic Pollution
Work with other organizations and networks and make Earth Day 2018 a platform to End Plastic Pollution by developing resources that others can use and build partnerships.
Promote the work that cities and local governments are doing to tackle plastic pollution
Empower journalists across the globe to report on the problem and its emerging solutions.
Earth Day Network will leverage the platform of Earth Day, April 22, 2018 and the growing excitement around the 50thAnniversary of Earth Day in 2020. We will work with key constituencies and influencers to build a world of educated consumers of all ages who understand the environmental, climate and health consequences of using plastics. We will engage and activate our global network of NGO’s and grassroots organizations, campus youth, mayors and other local elected leaders, faith leaders, artists and athletes, and primary and secondary students and teachers.We will organize events in all continents of the world, build a global following and activate citizens to join our End Plastic Pollution advocacy campaigns. In sum, we will use the power of Earth Day to elevate the issue of plastic pollution in the global agenda and inspire and demand effective action to reduce and control it.Sign the End Plastic Pollution PetitionMake a pledge to reduce your use of plasticSend your ideas or propose a partnership to plastic@earthday.org

There is no doubt at all—at least within us—that you are capable of anything that you decide you are capable of creating, becoming, having, or doing. There really is no limit to what it is that you can conceive of; and whatever it is that you can conceive of is something that you can actually experience, have, do, or be. We want to invite you today to start thinking more along these lines, and less about what it is that you do not have or cannot do or have not done. When you begin to turn your attention to the potential—or what is coming, and the possibilities of what you are creating, and to the expanded version of the you that you are becoming—what happens is that you begin to liberate yourself from the chains of the past, from the binds and the bounds that you have put upon yourself that keep you from believing in who you really are. Well, you see, we have no doubt about who you are; and at the core of your being you certainly have no doubt about this either, but you have trained yourself vibration ally to believe that somehow you are less than who you are: perfect and whole, right now. On the topic of money—on the topic of spinning straw into gold—knowing that anything is possible is the beginning of the realization that you can have what it is that you are wanting. When we discussed earlier the difference between making money and creating money, what we noticed is that most of you who are making money are doing so because you believe that this is the only way that you can get your needs met, this is the only way that you can take care of business, this is the only way that you can guarantee that what you are wanting—at least a little tiny portion of it that you believe you can have—is going to actually come to you. However, what we want you to understand is that when you are creating money, what you are doing is tapping into the infinite possibility, tapping into the infinite Source, tapping into the infinite abundance of All That Is. There really is no limit to what you can create. The only limitation that you ever have is the limitation that you place upon yourself. No one is that interested in you, to keep you repressed from who you are. Many well-intentioned people may be telling you, or have told you in the past, that if you think too big or dream too big that you're going to be disappointed, so it might be a better idea to stay close to home and keep things reasonable and moderated. We understand why that certainly would feel bet­ ter than the thought that you're living in a wildly chaotic universe. But here we intend to go further. We invite you to—as you go through this day—begin to imagine the biggest possible thing that you can imagine—whatever it may be—but particularly as it pertains to money. We don't necessarily mean thinking about large sums of money, although that may be part of what you're wanting. We invite you to just think big, no matter what the subject is, no matter how money is involved, whether you think money is necessary to have this or not. It doesn't really matter. We just invite you to think about and begin training yourself in the direction of a more expanded version of the you that you are becoming, particularly if you feel as though you are in a rut. This exercise—for as long as you do it and with as much or as little gusto as you put into the experience— will help you realize that there are other possibilities. You see, by engaging the Law of Attraction—the single organizing principle of the universe—in this little theme of expanded thinking, what you are doing is drawing to you more and more thoughts, more and more ideas, and eventually—as you allow it to happen— more experiences, more situations, more people that align with the bigger vision, the expanded version. In a way, we could say it is your destiny to become whatever it is that you are dreaming of. That is why we have said to you that your imagination is your most powerful tool. Do you want to be destined to a life where you feel as though there were missed opportunities or choices that you did not make that you could have made, or do you want to be destined for an expanding version of you? There's no right or wrong answer to this question. There are many good reasons—many good reasons —why you would want to do one over the other; but we suspect that if you really pay attention to what is going on within you, and notice the thoughts that you are thinking, and notice how you feel as you think these thoughts, you will find the more expanded thoughts to be more attractive thoughts. You will find them to feel better for you. As you explore what it means throughout the day to have an expanded vision—and as you think about what that would look like and what it would feel like to have whatever it is that you're dreaming of—we also invite you to pay attention to the fact that you really don't know how to get there, and see if you can be okay with that very simple fact. You see, it's always true that you really don't know how to get from one place to another. You think you do, from things that you've done over and over again, where it seems like the exact same thing happened, each step being the same along the way. But remember, each moment is a new moment and you're never really doing the same thing twice. This isn't just a metaphysical conceit or a philosophical truism; this is actually something that you can demonstrate by noticing that you are not exactly the same person that you were the last time you did something; and so if you are going to repeat it—let's say just the simple act of making a sandwich—you never really make the same sandwich twice, and you never really do exactly the same amount of this, that or the other. And as true as that is for something as small as a sandwich, it's mostly true—in fact, it's more so true—in fact, it's absolutely true—for anything else that you might be imagining. The wonderful thing is that you don't know how to get from here to there; and the wonderful thing is that since you do not know how to get there, you can train yourself—something that is quite natural for you to do if you allow it to happen—to be guided from here to there. Now, this guidance is not like an unseen hand that is moving you. This guidance is what naturally arises within you when you decide, “I will be over there from here.” As soon as you decide, “This is what I will have,” the way to get there is immediately established. And no matter how you follow—whether you do it exactly the way it lays out for you as you do it, or whether you hem and haw and procrastinate and can't make up your mind and aren't quite sure and can't quite get there—it doesn't matter how long you delay it —every moment has within it the ability to lead you to exactly where you want to go. There is no question that does not have an answer; and there is no destination that does not have a path to get there. And when you realize that it is your imagining—it is your dreaming—it is your ability to think of something more than where you are right in the moment in manifested reality—that is actually causing all of the really wonderful, delicious experiences to come to you— they don't just happen randomly; they happen because you dreamed them into being—then we think that you're probably going to want to spend a lot more time dreaming about who you are becoming, and imagining what it is that is possible, and feeling your way into the deliciousness of those possibilities, and beginning to notice how they are real more than they are not. We think that, as you do this, you are going to feel a connection that you have to that creative power that is within you—and this is your ability to literally spin straw into gold. For what is the straw but just the raw building blocks? It's just the potential—and what you are creating is gold as your dreams, and gold of your desires. Now, that gold may be actual gold, for all we know, or it may be cash dollars or pounds or euros or something else equally valuable in its own way. It may be qualities of experiences; it may be types of relationships; it may be just more delicious ideas. It doesn't really matter. Your ability to create is only limited by your imagination; and we know that from where you sit there is an infinite number of ideas at your fingertips. All you need do is turn your attention to what is bigger and broader and more expanded from where you are, and you will find all manner of delicious ideas waiting there to be discovered. And as you do so—as you see yourself there in the picture, having what you're wanting—as you feel yourself in alignment with what you know is coming—the way to get there will immediately present itself. The only delay will happen because you are not quite sure you can have what you're wanting. And so, our invitation for you today is to start loosening that up a little bit. Start dreaming a little bit bigger; start imagining a little bit more than what you've imagined before, and see if you can find a way to demonstrate for yourself that you can indeed have exactly what it is that you are wanting; and that what you are wanting—there is no limitation to this very, very delicious, very wonderful series of creations that are coming through you again and again. 

Photo Source: pexels.com
op.title: There is nothing that is limiting your ability to create what you want

https://steemitimages.com/DQmbXQ26KKmce59CXmStgv4aHGojpBLnfbin8w6jmdFZNs3/image.png https://steemitimages.com/DQmZH4W6rzTBGUuMw2VV7MPzVvA9B1UtcGpjMgcWvmSyEpT/Unnamed%20QQ%20Screenshot20180417172322.png Today, this is the eve of Memorial Day for the fallen soldiers of Israel, we will remember them forever

Yom Hazikaron From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia This article is about Israel's Memorial Day. For the holiday known liturgically as Yom Hazikaron, see Rosh Hashanah. Yom Hazikaron PikiWiki Israel 5670 war memorial in tel hashomer.jpg IDF soldiers participate in an official Yom Hazikaron ceremony to the fallen soldiers and the victims of terror attacks. Observed by Israelis Date 4 Iyar (Hebrew calendar) 2017 date 1 May 2018 date 18 April 2019 date 8 May 2020 date 28 April Related to Yom Ha'atzmaut Yom Hazikaron (Hebrew: יוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן‬; lit. "Memorial Day"), in full Yom Hazikaron l'Chalalei Ma'arachot Yisrael ul'Nifge'ei Pe'ulot Ha'eivah (Hebrew:יוֹם הזִּכָּרוֹן לַחֲלָלֵי מַעֲרָכוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל וּלְנִפְגְעֵי פְּעוּלוֹת הָאֵיבָה‬; lit. "Memorial Day for the Fallen Soldiers of Israel and Victims of Terrorism"), is Israel's official remembrance day, enacted into law in 1963. While Yom Hazikaron has been traditionally dedicated to fallen soldiers, commemoration has also been extended to civilian victims of terrorism. An IDF officer places new flags, each with a black ribbon, on the graves of IDF soldiers for Yom Hazikaron. IDF soldiers at Yom Hazikaron ceremony, 2007 Bedouin Soldiers Memorial. In 1949 and 1950, the first two years after the declaration of the State, memorial services for soldiers who fell in the War of Independence were held on Independence Day. Services at military cemeteries were coordinated between the IDF and the Ministry of Defense. A concern arose, expressed by families of fallen soldiers, to establish a separate memorial day observance distinct from the festive celebrations of national independence. In response, and in light of public debate on the issue, Prime Minister David Ben-Gurion – also serving as Minister of Defense – established in January 1951 the "Public Council for Soldiers' Commemoration". This council recommended establishing the 4th of Iyyar, the day preceding Independence Day, as the "General Memorial Day for the Heroes of the War of Independence". This proposal won government approval that same year. Observance Yom Hazikaron is the national remembrance day observed in Israel for all Israeli military personnel who lost their lives in the struggle that led to the establishment of the State of Israel and for those who have been killed subsequently while on active duty in Israel’s armed forces. As of Yom Hazikaron in 2018 that number was 23,645. By law, all places of entertainment are closed on the eve of Yom Hazikaron, and broadcasting and educational bodies note the solemnity of the day. Regular television programs cease for the day, and the names and ranks of every soldier who died for Israel are displayed in a 24-hour television broadcast. Memorial candles are lit in homes, army camps, schools, synagogues, and public places, and the flags are lowered to half staff. Throughout the day serving and retired military personnel serve as honor guards at war memorials throughout the country, and the families of the fallen participate in memorial ceremonies at military cemeteries. National memorial services are held in the presence of Israel's top leadership and military personnel. The day opens with a siren the preceding evening at 20:00 (8:00 pm), given that in the Hebrew calendar system, a day begins at sunset. The siren is heard all over the country and lasts for one minute, during which Israelis stop everything, including driving on highways, and stand in silence, commemorating the fallen and showing respect. Many traditional and religious Jews say prayers for the souls of the fallen soldiers on Yom Hazikaron. Special prayers prescribed by the Israeli rabbinate are recited. These include the recital of Psalms 9: "For the leader, on the death of the son," and Psalm 144: "Blessed be the Lord, My Rock, who traineth my hands for war and my fingers for battle" in addition to memorial prayers for the dead. The official ceremony to mark the opening of the day takes place at the Western Wall,. A two-minute siren is sounded at 11:00 the following morning, which marks the opening of the official memorial ceremonies and private remembrance gatherings at each cemetery where soldiers are buried. Many Israelis visit the resting places of loved ones throughout the day. The day officially draws to a close at sundown (between 19:00 and 20:00; 7–8 p.m.) in a ceremony at the national military cemetery on Mount Herzl, marking the start of Israel Independence Day, when the flag of Israel is returned to full staff. Channel 33 has screened the names of all civilians killed in pogroms since 1851, and all fallen from 1860 (considered the date of the beginning of the Yishuv by the Israeli Ministry of Defense), in chronological order (rank, name, Hebrew date deceased and secular date) over the course of the day. This has been mentioned in the West Wing episode "Memorial Day";[16] However, it is unknown whether or not this will continue following the replacement of the Israeli Broadcasting Authority by the Israeli Public Broadcasting Corporation. Scheduling Yom Hazikaron right before Yom Ha-Atzma'ut is intended to remind people of the price paid for independence and of what was achieved with the soldiers' sacrifice.[17] This transition shows the importance of this day among Israelis, most of whom have served in the armed forces or have a connection with people who were killed during their military service. Timing To avoid the possibility of Sabbath desecration should either Yom Hazikaron or Yom Ha'atzma'ut take place on Saturday night, both are observed one or two days earlier (the 3rd and 4th, or the 2nd and 3rd, of Iyar) when the 5th of Iyar falls on a Friday or Saturday (Shabbat). Likewise, when Yom Hazikaron falls on Saturday night/Sunday day, both observances are rescheduled to one day later.

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yom_Hazikaron

Old City of Rosh Pina in the Galilee – History and Galleries in Rosh Pina Rosh Pina was worked in 1882 as a rural town. It now houses around 2500 individuals. The first town is currently a vacationer site with old memorable houses, workmanship exhibitions, and bistros. In 1878, eighteen religious Jews from Tzfat went to the region to cultivate the land. They would not like to take philanthropy from European Jews and were resolved to procure their own keep. Shockingly, following three years of draft they surrendered and came back to Tzfat. Educator Mer's home In 1882, a gathering of thirty families originated from Romania and fabricated the town of Rosh Pina. Noble de Rothschild gave the group his help from 1883. Land was bought from the neighborhood Arabs, who required the cash for influences to keep their children out of the Turkish armed force. The first families wanted to angle in the nearby streams. When they saw the streams, they understood that angling was impossible, so they utilized their wooden water crafts for the synagogue rooftop. The primary building fabricated was the mikve, and after that came the synagogue and other little homes. A portion of the first families lived in slope hollows until the point when their homes were constructed. Cultivating was unfamiliar to them, and they were tormented with troubles. They endeavored to plant mulberry trees to develop silkworms and blooms to make fragrance. Neither of these thoughts worked. Regardless of the challenges of the first ranchers, the town is presently a flourishing excursion site, with bistros, exhibitions, and Bed and Breakfasts. perspective of the old burial ground Attractions: Synagogue – worked by Baron de Rothschild The Mer house – Professor Gideon Mer a specialist in the study of disease transmission, was associated with the annihilation of jungle fever in the 1930s. ### The billionaire investor attacked the virtual currency phenomenon last January, but it has now been reported that the fund under his leadership is planning investments in the field
> Source: https://www.calcalist.co.il / Bloomberg 

> ![image.png](https://gateway.ipfs.io/ipfs/QmYpceP9L56CTAp4KDhareT51bNxoAkHQxn6hVFoHi5Lq1)
> Source: Bloomberg


Sources familiar with the matter said that Adam Fisher, who manages macro investments at the Soros fund in New York, has been approved to trade such currencies in recent months, although he has not yet done so in practice. A spokesman for the company declined to comment.

 
Soros said during a Davos forum three months ago that virtual currencies can not be used as replaceable currencies due to their volatility, although he did not foresee the sharp fall that occurred in them, as did various experts at the time. He warned against using dictatorships in virtual currencies to keep their assets abroad, since the Bettkin fell by 41 percent after sharp rises in the last months of 2017.

 

However, other investors have begun to invest in this field. For example, a fund manager of the hedge Mike Nobogratz fact frozen the plan to launch a virtual currency in December, but instead turned to the establishment of a commercial bank that focuses on this type of currencies and relevant technology-related initiatives.

 

Some investors have turned to the field when the profits of their hedge funds began to dwindle. John Burbank, who closed his central fund last year, plans to raise $ 150 million for two funds that invest in virtual currencies. The Passport Capital Fund he founded began operations in January. Billionaire Alan Howard has made acquisitions separately from the company he owns over the past year and plans to invest more of his money in digital assets and in Lockchine technology.

Soros has already invested in virtual currencies, but only indirectly. The company acquired shares in Overstock.com during the fourth quarter, making it the third largest investor in the e-commerce company. Last August, the latter became the first major trading company to receive virtual currencies. Last month, its shares plummeted 40% after reporting that the US Securities and Exchange Commission was investigating its bid to issue a virtual currency.

Last week we celebrated the holiday of the Passover

During Passover there is a one-week vacation ,During this week most of the people in our country go hiking and picnics in nature and in the gardens

We are a group of childhood friends from the same village, Over the years we have a tradition of trips and events that we do regularly every year

On Passover, we chose to spend a weekend together on the banks of the Jordan River,

Our main goal is to make good time together, forming, laughing, and spending the best time together

In the next post I will upload a few pictures from our camping from last weekend with small explanations beside each photo

We have just arrived, during the holiday all the gardens, the sea, the rivers, and nature reserves. All the places are filled with people who go on vacation in nature .. We had a key to a private place on the banks of the Jordan River, waiting for a quiet and isolated weekend, at the height of the busy season.


And when we arrived, we discovered another family that had received the key to the private place. We agreed that we would arrange and spend the night in the same location. We stayed for a few days,

It was all right for everyone (You can see them from behind)

We just arrived. And directly plans on fishing in the river immediately


Shai is already making us comfortable firewood for the night


Hi, this is sweet Babe has a good time



The evening is coming, and we're making a crazy dinner.

We love to make luxurious area dinners

In the area we were in. There was no cellular reception at all, we were totally cut off from the world, I think it made us find more quality time for talk and meetings, and less distractions

All of our events, we fund together, each pays an equal amount and together buy everything that is needed.

On this trip we made a vote to make a joint fund for all members to buy camping equipment that will serve us on our trips and joint events.

The proposal passed by a majority vote!


There's nothing like sitting by the fire!

MORNING!

A morning cocktail, amazing and delicious in frenzy


How did I forget the point? It is the river itself, in its mountainous and rocky part

FOOD!!!

The first fish after many years of attempts

As you've probably noticed, these sessions are usually for men only!

The reasons are for the common good! We respect women very much!


There are many more pictures, but I'll put the last picture to the end.

I want to introduce you to my friend Jon Jon. Which is Mr. Good Time!

Jon Jon worries and makes all these encounters happen, he collects money from everyone, and arranges all things so that everything will function

He is an excellent cook of the best

And a totally crazy guy

Maybe one day you'll hear about him because he's a real cannon


Hope you enjoyed the pictures and the guys.

I hope to receive a lot of votes and comments here

Thank you all! A sea of love!
op.title: A trip of my childhood friends to the Jordan River

op.body:
https://steemitimages.com/DQmVZ7U5aVnVRiqKrTufM2ES6bEdbb2ZBnDtaDbLaPPBuWw/29599400_23842751704950254_4997306405808504832_n.png.jpg

 

Date of birth

Our birth date describes us, our character and our behavior and can even affect them.
What does it mean?
According to numerology each birth date has one number.
And you can calculate the number.

How do I get my birth date number?

For example:
born on 5.3.1977 calculate like this: 5 + 3 + 1 + 9 + 7 + 7 = 32 and now 3 + 2 = 5
5 This is the number.
Now all that remains is to check the meaning of the number

People equal to 1

Features: leadership, dynamism, control and independence. These people are real pioneers, courageous, opinionated,
well-informed, focused, honest and motivated, qualities that enable them to conquer their different goals one by one.
For them the only failure is to stop trying. These people tend to hide their feelings even by themselves, and prefer not to reveal the deepest parts of them.
They want the attention and consent of those around them, and radiate power, confidence, and self-respect.


Career: In labor relations, they tend to be bossy,
and they will choose whatever way they can to achieve their goals. Usually they are attracted to independent work, and even when they decide to work within a framework, they will usually turn to management positions.


What to avoid:When they misuse the existing potential in their full name, they sin selfishly, domineering, stubbornly, in pursuit of honor, exploitation and even aggression that sometimes leads to cruelty.


Exhaustion: In order to succeed in their lives, they need to know the limits, to be patient and balanced, and to feel part of the whole while maintaining their individuality.

People equal to 2

Main characteristics: sensitivity and high intuition, imagination, co-existence, love and trust. They think before they perform, look calm and friendly,
take diplomacy and tact, love peace, enjoy the company, adapt themselves to the environment and know how to quickly identify imbalances in people or objects, and bridge social gaps.


Career: They believe in teamwork, and often prefer to give priority to others. They are not competitive or leaders,
and they usually know and can best execute the plans of others.


What to avoid: When they take advantage of the negative potential existing in the number of their full name, their great sensitivity causes them to eruptions and loss of self-control.
They become critical, easily hurt, disappointed in their environment, and often suffer from restlessness and mood swings. They tend to be shy, emotional, insecure,
Excessive self-indulgence, negligence and idleness and even develop ongoing dependence.


Exhaustion: They must learn to be more determined, to develop their confidence and dignity, to stand up for themselves and to beware of fantasies

People equal to 3

Main characteristics: expression of freedom of speech, creativity, good communication, motility and joy of life.
They are child lovers, talented, highly intuitive, imaginative and generous, enjoy talking about everything and strive to understand others.
They have a tendency to perfection, inner sensitivity, and impatience with marginal matters. They tend to be good friends and appreciate very honesty, sincerity and true friendship.


Career: These people were called upon to serve others, and were given the opportunity to do so in any way possible, in both personal and public life. In order to succeed, they must learn to concentrate and focus.


What to Avoid: When they take advantage of the existing potential in their full name, they tend to disperse forces, thoughts and resources, drawing attention only to themselves and caring only for their convenience.
Sometimes it seems that they never grew up, and when they get into an imbalance optimism becomes doubt, and enthusiasm is interpreted as stupidity.


Exhaustion: In order to succeed in their lives, they must create a joy of life, and avoid distraction, self-sufficiency, sadness and gloom, pride, exaggeration, waste, impatience,
irresponsibility and a desire for freedom at all costs.

https://steemitimages.com/DQmbJbyiKg4GFzA5ze4eQphpmags3MT4Dn2RE36z3NwdbrF/29841564_23842751705090254_1206868544407470080_n.png.jpg

People equal to 4

Main characteristics: logic, order, intelligence, fixed frames, power (even physical) and determination.
Their guiding principle is building a strong and stable foundation. They have a constant need for consistent security in all sectors of life.
Their standards are particularly high, leading them to disappointment in the environment when they do not meet the standards expected of them.


Career: These people have very good management and organization skills, both skillfully and systematically.
Sometimes life teaches them to deal with various restrictions, which emphasizes the need for perseverance, work and processing of details.
Because of the need for security they invest many hours in work, and they have to learn to balance this with proper rest.


What to Avoid: When they take advantage of the negative potential of their full name, they tend to be stubborn and overly suspicious,
bossy and constantly worried about their safety.


Extraction:In order to succeed in their lives, they must avoid shortcuts, make them more efficient and develop greater flexibility and lightness towards themselves and the environment.
They must broaden their horizons and go ahead with progress. They would do well to devote their time not only to material construction, but also to spiritual and spiritual construction

People equal to 5

Main characteristics: freedom, sexuality, desire for change, dynamism, good communication. They have an analytical ability, a remarkable adaptability, a
sense of distinction and a highly developed critical sense. Verbal communication is the basis for the influence of these people on the environment.
They desire to accumulate knowledge and set themselves different challenges, which will form the basis for creating frequent changes. Routine makes them restless.
Some tend to increase sexual attachments only for sexual release. They may also have questions about their sexual identity.


Career: The combination of their qualities allows them the flexibility of thinking and the ability to engage in several areas simultaneously. They are charismatic entrepreneurs who love their personal freedom.
Mental restlessness runs them in parallel to several directions where they are able to control well. When the responsibility lies on their heads, they tend to change moods.
They like to take some calculated risks, and occasionally gamble to get quick money.


What to Avoid: When they take advantage of the potential of their full name, they tend to be decisionless and irresponsible, lazy, restless,
self-destructing, extreme, impulsive, degenerate, humiliating, abusive and angry. With the power of expression, they are able to gain the
trust of those around them very easily, and exploit it miserably to deceive, deceive, deceive, and mislead those who rely on them.


Exhaustion: In order to succeed in their lives, it is best to focus on the goals, to control the inner impulses and impulses, to learn the lessons from those around them,
to open doors for themselves and not to escape from experiences and commitments.

People equal to 6

Main characteristics: love, harmonious environment, giving, beauty, aesthetics. These people are talented and insist on stability and constant control.
They know how to help others, show a sense of responsibility towards their relatives, maintain individuality and are attracted to people.
They are exemplary family members, and wonderful hosts. These people were endowed with personal attraction, nobility and a developed sense of justice.
Proper processing of processes is very important for them, and for them everything has to have a meaning and a logical reason.
They have principles, morality, ethics and a tendency to perfection, sometimes too much. They are usually loyal to whom they love,
and discover their feelings without hesitation. Their motto is "Love your neighbor as yourself." They have a need to love and be loved,
and living without love seems empty of them.


Career:They are teachers from birth. Some are drawn to the various arts. They are able to succeed in their actions mainly when there is a force that motivates them and praises them.


What to avoid: When they take advantage of the potential existing in the number of their full name, they will be immoral, lazy, stingy or wasteful and are in fear and concern.
Tyranny, selfishness, skepticism, and intrigue, excessive criticism, and the pursuit of extra pleasure will occupy a significant place in their lives.


Exhaustion: In order to succeed in their lives, they must realize that the number of their full name is composed of two equal and balanced parts, but when the balance is breached they may enter unnecessary conflicts and wars.
They must learn to recognize their shortcomings and create a harmonious and loving environment around them, because most of their problems are related to the foundation of the family unit, lack of love and lack of respect.

People equal to 7

Main features: rich inner world, curiosity, dreams. They were born with a great deal of inner knowledge and needed a great deal of free time to reflect,
study, explore and deepen their thoughts, to fill batteries and continue on their way. They are intellectual types, with an analytical mind and a propensity for philosophy.
They have strong intuitions, a developed mystical sense, and the ability to heal body and mind. They do not trust others, and lose patience when you do not understand them.


Career: They prefer to work alone, or independently behind the scenes, and tend to perfection in all their actions.
Because of the difficulty in expressing their feelings correctly, most of their partnerships end in failure.


What to avoid: When they take advantage of the negative potential existing in the number of their full name,
they enter a state of confusion between reality and what they see in the spiritual eye.
They usually cut themselves off from the environment, sink into bad moods and even become addicted to alcohol and drugs to escape reality.
Some develop a fear of abandonment that prevents them from confronting life.


Exhaustion: In order to succeed, they must learn to grow and develop from within themselves. All the answers are within them,
so it is good if they learn to control their negative thoughts, and will not allow fears to lead them.
They must learn to express themselves properly, and not expect others to understand them as they understand themselves.
https://steemitimages.com/DQmQvUza2RqsZ5vrKvTgEKqcHQv5SqYxAgoQcsB88FVXfde/29619939_23842751705220254_3949047803891679232_n.png.jpg

People equal to 8

Main characteristics: discipline, consistency, practicality, authority, power and concentration.
They organize their lives very thoroughly, love their home and seek balance.
They know how to see both sides of the coin, and plan their steps on the way to the target.
Sometimes they give the wrong impression of cold people. They have a lot of energy and a consistent and persistent character,
and can even be hot-tempered. It is very difficult to change their character. They are not always able to deal with the emotional side,
fearing loss of power and control, and prefer to express themselves through expensive gifts and providing
financial security to their relatives.


Career: People with a great deal of inner strength and the ability to execute their plans.
They can be competitive and have a good and proper approach to the business world.


What to avoid: When they take advantage of the negative potential existing in the number of their full name,
They tend to be over-ambitious and striving for power, authority, and total control. This is expressed in selfishness, manipulativeness, the lack
of opportunities for others and even the destruction of their environment. They do not always forgive, and can even blame others for their actions.


Exhaustion: In order to succeed in their lives, they must learn to use the secret of balance they hold.
In most cases, life will teach them how to deal with various limitations, to remind them of their true abilities.

People equal to 9

Main characteristics: energy dynamism, justice, universal love, compassion.
They have a broad perspective and fertile imagination, gifted with understanding, magnetism, generosity, a desire to help others,
sympathy and generosity for the weak. These qualities give them warmth and love from which they feed.
Sometimes life teaches them to give up their personal needs, and sacrifice themselves to allow others to progress
because they are mentors to those who come after them. They are usually not afraid of anything and of man,
and are capable of dealing with all the circumstances of the world. On the other hand, they have many powerful energies that,
if not properly channeled, can lead to nervousness and outbursts.
They tend to draw conclusions too early and throw the consequences into their lives, which usually does not do them any good.


Career: They are able to achieve fulfillment and self-fulfillment through humanitarian service.
Their power comes from providing service, information, teaching and guidance to others, which will be done universally,
without expectation of recognition. They are intellectual types, who excel in organization and management.


What to avoid: When they take advantage of the potential existing in the number of their full name, domination,
sarcasm, selfishness, superfluous irritability, lack of self-control and immorality become an integral part of them.


Exhaustion: In order to succeed in their lives they must learn not to treat people, places,
objects and habits in a personal way, especially in situations of separation or loss. Their role is to be merciful, and not selfish.

Engagement rings from the dawn of history

The history of engagement rings can be said to have begun when the Romans began to wear a simple iron ring to symbolize their marriage. They began a tradition that remained and improved over the years. Around the 2nd century CE, gold replaced iron as a metal ring and thus institutionalized the traditional wedding ring and about 1300 years later the first diamond was added to the ceremony. Platinum came later, and around 1900 it became an alternative to gold ... but how engagement rings became part of our wedding and wedding ceremonies.

Before engagement rings .. Wedding rings

The circle was always of mystical importance in ancient cultures as the symbol of perfection, an item without beginning and end and a symbol of unity and uniformity. It is also the symbol of the sun, earth and the world and symbolizes whole holiness and peace. Long before the custom of engagement rings, our ancient ancestors confined themselves to their wives with a woolen string to symbolize their spirits.

In ancient cultures it was believed that the third finger in the third hand had a special vein, the vein of love, which linked the ring finger to the heart. This romantic theory has no scientific basis, of course, but the tradition has been going on for generations. It was King Edward III who declared that the third finger was the official ring of wedding rings, and in 1549 the decision was signed in the form of the Book of Prayers. And yet in many countries in Europe it is customary to wear wedding rings on the right hand and an engagement ring in the left hand or on the same hand.

But why gold?

The Egyptians, who made large quantities of gold, designated it mainly for the pharaohs, after all, who else could be worthy of wearing the symbol of the sun? Almost all the inhabitants of ancient and certainly those with access to gold raw material began to use gold in the most important ceremonies in their culture and incorporated it in funeral ceremonies for their dead. The Greeks and Romans who used gold for trade purposes between the countries established the gold status as a valuable raw material throughout Europe. In Asia, gold has become widely used in jewelry used in ceremonies to a similar extent to Western counterparts. In Africa, disputes have arisen between tribes, all because of the glittering material presented to them by Westerners, and experts estimate that about 100,000 tons of gold have been extracted from the earth in history, and since mining and processing takes long and expensive periods, gold has always been expensive. The years were able to process the gold into different shades by adding other elements. Gold processors can create yellow, red, green and white gold, in the same way that gold can be reinforced or weakened and thus be adapted to processing for different needs. With its many designs and numerous processing possibilities for gold, it is no surprise that gold has become and remains universal in its value. Today, most of the engagement rings and wedding rings are made of gold.

Engagement rings - a match between a diamond and a ring

The diamond was not traditionally raised to the Golden Ring. It was a mixture of cultures and customs that created the connection between gold and diamonds. The diamonds represented the light and purity, and the connection between the round gold ring symbolizing unity and together with the sparkling diamond symbolizing purity and light suddenly seemed very natural. Legend has it that the spark of the diamond symbolized the flames of love between lovers, and so the diamond became the symbol of lovers. The first diamonds were discovered in India, and the residents appreciated them very much because they believed that diamonds protected them, and that they provided good health and protection against any evil spirit. The Indians also knew how to rank among the various diamonds in a way that matched the differences in the classes in this country. The bigger the diamond was, the more white and glittering the more the holder was considered. Techniques in the processing and cutting of the diamonds created the jeweler of the Middle Ages an opportunity to experiment with different styles and mixtures of gold and diamonds, thus creating a gold ring studded with diamond. The engagement rings as we know them today are the embodiment of gold rings studded with diamonds, the rings have undergone various incarnations since the dawn of history and today constitute a promise in the form of precious jewels for marriage. Engagement rings are relevant for the perpetuation of the marital relationship. A wedding is not a public domain. Sometimes the couple will prefer to give up the wedding and remain a common-law partner.
